86// The main routine for the SIM driver
87int main( int const argc, char *argv[] )
88{
89 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s %d.%02d%c (%s %s)", CAM_STRINGIZE(__DEVB_NAME__),
90 SDMMC_SIM_VERSION / 100, SDMMC_SIM_VERSION % 100, SDMMC_SIM_LETTER,
91 __DATE__, __TIME__ );
92
93 memset( &sdmmc_ctrl, 0, sizeof( SDMMC_CTRL ) );
94
95 TAILQ_INIT( &sdmmc_ctrl.hlist );
96
97 sdmmc_ctrl.argc = argc;
98 sdmmc_ctrl.argv = argv;
99 sdmmc_ctrl.priority = SDMMC_SCHED_PRIORITY;
100
101#ifdef SDMMC_TRACE
102 sdmmc_trace_start( );
103 sdmmc_trace_event( SDMMC_TRACE_EVENT, "SDMMC Trace" );
104 sdmmc_trace_stop( );
105#endif
106
107 return( cam_configure( &sim_module, 1, argc, argv ) );
108}

110static SIM_HBA *sdmmc_alloc_hba( void )
111{
112 SIM_HBA *hba;
113 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
114
115 hba = sim_alloc_hba( sizeof( SIM_SDMMC_EXT ) );
116 if( hba == NULL ) {
117 return( NULL );
118 }
119
120 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
121
122 hba->pathid = -1;
123 hba->coid = -1;
124 hba->chid = -1;
125 hba->tid = -1;
126 hba->iid = hba->pathid;
127 hba->verbosity = sdmmc_ctrl.verbosity;
128 ext->ntargs = 0;
129 hba->priority = sdmmc_ctrl.priority;
130 ext->pm_timerid = -1;
131
132#ifdef SDMMC_POWMAN_SUP
133 ext->powman_hdl = NULL;
134#endif
135
136 ext->start_ccb_max = SDMMC_START_CCB_MAX;
137
138 ext->assd_active_sec_sys = -1;
139
140 memset( &ext->instance, SDIO_CONNECT_WILDCARD, sizeof( sdio_device_instance_t ) );
141
142 // add hba to drivers hba list
143 pthread_sleepon_lock( );
144 TAILQ_INSERT_TAIL( &sdmmc_ctrl.hlist, hba, hlink );
145 sdmmc_ctrl.nhba++;
146 pthread_sleepon_unlock( );
147
148// cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s: hba %p", __FUNCTION__, hba );
149
150 return( hba );
151}

153static int sdmmc_free_hba( SIM_HBA *hba )
154{
155 pthread_sleepon_lock( );
156 TAILQ_REMOVE( &sdmmc_ctrl.hlist, hba, hlink );
157 sdmmc_ctrl.nhba--;
158 pthread_sleepon_unlock( );
159 sim_free_hba( hba );
160
161// cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s: hba %p", __FUNCTION__, hba );
162 return( CAM_SUCCESS );
163}

165#ifndef SIM_BS_PARTITION_CONFIG
166static int sdmmc_partition_enum( SIM_HBA * const hba )
167{
168 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
169 SDMMC_PARTITION *part;
170 uint8_t *ecsd;
171 uint32_t pidx;
172 uint32_t pconf;
173 uint32_t nlba;
174 uint64_t gp_size;
175 uint64_t wp_grp_size;
176
177 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
178 ecsd = sdio_get_raw_ecsd( ext->device );
179 pconf = ecsd[ECSD_PART_CONFIG] & ~ECSD_PC_ACCESS_MSK;
180 wp_grp_size = (uint64_t )ecsd[ECSD_HC_WP_GRP_SIZE ] * (uint64_t )ecsd[ECSD_ERASE_GRP_SIZE ] * MMC_ERASE_GRP_512K;
181
182 // boot area partitions (1/2)
183 for( pidx = 0; pidx < MMC_BOOT_PART_MAX; pidx++ ) {
184 part = &ext->targets[1 + pidx].partitions[0];
185 part->config = pconf | ( 1 + pidx );
186 part->slba = 0;
187 part->nlba = (uint64_t)ecsd[ECSD_BOOT_SIZE_MULT] * MMC_BOOT_SIZE_MULT / 512;
188 part->elba = part->nlba - 1;
189 strlcpy( part->name, "boot", sizeof( part->name ) );
190 if( ( ecsd[ECSD_PARTITIONING_SUP] & ECSD_PS_PART_EN ) ) {
191 part->pflags |= SDMMC_PFLAG_ENH;
192 }
193 ext->ntargs++;
194 }
195
196 // RPMB area
197 part = &ext->targets[3].partitions[0];
198 part->config = pconf | 3;
199 part->slba = 0;
200 part->nlba = (uint64_t)ecsd[ECSD_RPMB_SIZE_MULT] * MMC_RPMB_SIZE_MULT / 512;
201 part->elba = part->slba + part->nlba - 1;
202 strlcpy(part->name, "rpmb", sizeof(part->name));
203 ext->ntargs++;
204
205 // GP partitions
206 for( pidx = 0; pidx < MMC_GP_PART_MAX; pidx++ ) {
207 gp_size = (uint64_t)ecsd[ECSD_GP_SIZE + 0 + ( pidx * 3 ) ];
208 gp_size |= (uint64_t)ecsd[ECSD_GP_SIZE + 1 + ( pidx * 3 ) ] << 8;
209 gp_size |= (uint64_t)ecsd[ECSD_GP_SIZE + 2 + ( pidx * 3 ) ] << 16;
210 nlba = ( gp_size * wp_grp_size ) / 512;
211
212 part = &ext->targets[ 4 + pidx].partitions[0];
213 part->config = pconf | ( 4 + pidx );
214 part->slba = 0;
215 part->nlba = nlba;
216 part->elba = nlba ? ( part->nlba - 1 ) : 0;
217 strlcpy(part->name, "gp", sizeof(part->name));
218 ext->ntargs++;
219
220 if( ( ecsd[ECSD_PARTITIONS_ATTR] & ( ECSD_PA_ENH_1 << pidx ) ) ) {
221 part->pflags |= SDMMC_PFLAG_ENH;
222 }
223 }
224
225 return( EOK );
226}
227#endif

229static int sdmmc_partition_config( SIM_HBA * const hba )
230{
231 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
232 SDMMC_TARGET *targ;
233 SDMMC_PARTITION *part;
234 uint8_t *ecsd;
235 uint64_t nlba;
236 uint32_t tidx;
237 uint32_t blksz;
238
239 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
240 targ = ext->targets;
241 part = targ->partitions;
242
243 nlba = ext->dev_inf.sectors;
244 blksz = ext->dev_inf.sector_size;
245
246 for( tidx = 0; tidx < SDMMC_TARGET_MAX; tidx++ ) {
247 targ = &ext->targets[tidx];
248 targ->blksz = blksz;
249 }
250
251 if( ( ext->dev_inf.flags & DEV_FLAG_WP ) ) {
252 part->pflags |= SDMMC_PFLAG_WP;
253 }
254
255 part->config = 0;
256 part->slba = 0;
257 part->nlba = nlba;
258 part->elba = nlba - 1;
259 strlcpy( part->name, "uda", sizeof( part->name ) );
260
261 if( ext->instance.ident.dtype == DEV_TYPE_MMC ) {
262 ecsd = sdio_get_raw_ecsd( ext->device );
263 part->config = ecsd[ECSD_PART_CONFIG] & ~ECSD_PC_ACCESS_MSK;
264#ifdef SIM_BS_PARTITION_CONFIG
265 sim_bs_partition_config( hba );
266#else
267 if( ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_PARTITIONS ) ) {
268 sdmmc_partition_enum( hba );
269 }
270#endif
271 }
272
273 return( CAM_SUCCESS );
274}

276static int sdmmc_dev_cfg( SIM_HBA * const hba )
277{
278 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
279 uint8_t *ecsd;
280 int status;
281
282 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
283 status = CAM_SUCCESS;
284
285// cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s", __FUNCTION__ );
286
287 if( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_CACHE ) ) {
288 if( sdio_cache( ext->device, ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_CACHE ) ? SDIO_CACHE_ENABLE : SDIO_CACHE_DISABLE, SDIO_TIME_DEFAULT ) != EOK ) {
289 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: Error %s volatile cache", __FUNCTION__, ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_CACHE ) ? "Enabling" : "Disabling" );
290 ext->eflags &= ~SDMMC_EFLAG_CACHE;
291 }
292 }
293
294 if( ext->instance.ident.dtype == DEV_TYPE_MMC ) {
295 ecsd = sdio_get_raw_ecsd( ext->device );
296 if( ( ecsd[ ECSD_BKOPS_EN ] & ECSD_BKOPS_ENABLE ) ) { // check ECSD for manual BKOPS permanent setting
297 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s: ECSD Manual BKOPS enabled", __FUNCTION__ );
298 ext->eflags |= SDMMC_EFLAG_BKOPS;
299 }
300
301 if( sdmmc_bkops_cfg( hba, CAM_TRUE ) != EOK ) {
302 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: Error Enabling BKOPS", __FUNCTION__ );
303 ext->eflags &= ~SDMMC_EFLAG_BKOPS;
304 }
305
306 if( ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_RELWR ) && !( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_WR_REL ) ) {
307 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: WARNING Reliable Write Requested, but not supported by HW", __FUNCTION__ );
308 ext->eflags &= ~SDMMC_EFLAG_RELWR;
309 }
310 }
311
312 if( ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_PWROFF_NOTIFY ) ) {
313 if( sdio_pwroff_notify( ext->device, ECSD_POWERED_ON, SDIO_TIME_DEFAULT ) != EOK ) {
314 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: Error Power Off Notify On", __FUNCTION__ );
315 ext->eflags &= ~SDMMC_EFLAG_PWROFF_NOTIFY;
316 }
317 }
318
319 if( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_ASSD ) ) {
320 sdmmc_assd_init( hba );
321 }
322
323#ifdef SIM_BS_DEV_CFG
324 status = sim_bs_dev_cfg( hba );
325#endif
326
327 return( status );
328}

330static int sdmmc_dev_dcfg( SIM_HBA * const hba )
331{
332 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
333 int status;
334
335 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
336 status = CAM_SUCCESS;
337
338// cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s", __FUNCTION__ );
339
340 // Flush volatile cache
341 if( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_CACHE ) && ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_CACHE ) ) {
342 status = sdio_cache( ext->device, SDIO_CACHE_FLUSH, SDIO_TIME_DEFAULT * 5 );
343 if( status != EOK ) {
344 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: Error Cache Flush", __FUNCTION__ );
345 }
346 }
347
348 // Switch off Device BKOPS (eMMC 5.1)
349 if( ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_BKOPS_AUTO ) ) {
350 if( ( status = sdmmc_bkops_cfg( hba, CAM_FALSE ) ) ) {
351 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: Error Disabling auto BKOPS", __FUNCTION__ );
352 }
353 }
354
355 // Send notification ECSD_POWER_OFF_SHORT/ECSD_POWER_OFF_LONG to the device
356 if( ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_PWROFF_NOTIFY ) ) {
357 status = sdio_pwroff_notify( ext->device, ext->pwroff_notify, SDIO_TIME_DEFAULT );
358 if( status != EOK ) {
359 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: Error Power Off Notify", __FUNCTION__ );
360 }
361 }
362
363 return( status );
364}

366static int sdmmc_detach( SIM_HBA *hba, const int hba_free )
367{
368 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
369 int ret;
370 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
371
372// cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s: hba %p, %s", __FUNCTION__, hba, hba_free ? "free", "keep" );
373
374 if( hba->pathid != -1 ) {
375 xpt_bus_deregister( hba->pathid );
376 }
377
378 if( hba->coid != -1 ) {
379 ConnectDetach( hba->coid );
380 }
381
382 if( hba->chid != -1 ) {
383 ChannelDestroy( hba->chid );
384 }
385
386 if( hba->tid != -1 ) {
387 ret = pthread_join( hba->tid, NULL );
388 if (ret != EOK) {
389 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: pthread_join failed(%s)", __func__, strerror(ret) );
390 }
391
392 }
393
394 if( ext->pm_timerid != -1 ) {
395 timer_delete( ext->pm_timerid );
396 }
397
398#ifdef SDMMC_POWMAN_SUP
399 sdmmc_powman_disconnect( hba );
400#endif
401
402 if( hba->simq ) {
403 simq_dinit( hba->simq );
404 }
405
406 if( ext->device ) {
407 sdmmc_dev_dcfg( hba );
408 sdio_detach( ext->device );
409 }
410
411#ifdef SDMMC_WRITE_VERIFY
412 if( ext->ver_vaddr ) {
413 xpt_free( ext->ver_vaddr, SDMMC_VER_BSIZE );
414 ext->ver_vaddr = NULL;
415 }
416#endif
417
418 hba->pathid = -1;
419 hba->coid = -1;
420 hba->chid = -1;
421 hba->tid = -1;
422 ext->pm_timerid = -1;
423 ext->device = NULL;
424 hba->simq = NULL;
425
426 if( hba_free == CAM_TRUE ) {
427 sdmmc_free_hba( hba );
428 }
429 else {
430 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s: keep 0x%p", __FUNCTION__, hba );
431 }
432
433 return( CAM_SUCCESS );
434}

436static int sdmmc_reg( SIM_HBA *hba )
437{
438 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
439 pthread_attr_t attr;
440 struct sched_param param;
441 int policy;
442 int ret;
443
444 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
445
446 ret = pthread_attr_init( &attr );
447 if (ret != EOK) {
448 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: pthread_attr_init failed(%s)", __func__, strerror(ret) );
449 return (-1);
450 }
451
452 ret = pthread_attr_setschedpolicy( &attr, SCHED_RR );
453 if (ret != EOK) {
454 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: pthread_attr_setschedpolicy failed(%s)", __func__, strerror(ret) );
455 return (-1);
456 }
457
458 ret = pthread_getschedparam( pthread_self( ), &policy, &param );
459 if (ret != EOK) {
460 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: pthread_getschedparam failed(%s)", __func__, strerror(ret) );
461 return (-1);
462 }
463
464 param.sched_priority = hba->priority;
465
466 ret = pthread_attr_setschedparam( &attr, &param );
467 if (ret != EOK) {
468 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: pthread_attr_setschedparam failed(%s)", __func__, strerror(ret) );
469 return (-1);
470 }
471
472 ret = pthread_attr_setinheritsched( &attr, PTHREAD_EXPLICIT_SCHED );
473 if (ret != EOK) {
474 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: pthread_attr_setinheritsched failed(%s)", __func__, strerror(ret) );
475 return (-1);
476 }
477
478 ret = pthread_attr_setstacksize( &attr, CAM_STACK_SIZE );
479 if (ret != EOK) {
480 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: pthread_attr_setstacksize failed(%s)", __func__, strerror(ret) );
481 return (-1);
482 }
483
484#ifdef SDMMC_WRITE_VERIFY
485 if( ( ext->ver_vaddr = xpt_alloc( XPT_ALLOC_CONTIG | XPT_ALLOC_NOCACHE, SDMMC_VER_BSIZE, NULL ) ) == MAP_FAILED ) {
486 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: xpt_alloc verify buffer failure", __FUNCTION__ );
487 return( CAM_FAILURE );
488 }
489
490 ext->ver_paddr = xpt_vtop( ext->ver_vaddr, NULL );
491#endif
492
493 if( cam_create_thread( &hba->tid, &attr, sdmmc_driver_thread, hba, hba->priority, &hba->state, "sdmmc_driver_thread" ) != EOK ) {
494 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: sdmmc_driver_thread creation failure", __FUNCTION__ );
495 return( CAM_FAILURE );
496 }
497
498 atomic_set( &ext->eflags, SDMMC_EFLAG_PRESENT );
499
500 hba->pathid = xpt_bus_register( &sdmmc_sim_entry, hba );
501
502 if( hba->pathid > sdmmc_ctrl.pathid_max ) {
503 sdmmc_ctrl.pathid_max = hba->pathid;
504 }
505
506 xpt_async( AC_SIM_REGISTER, hba->pathid, -1, -1, NULL, 0 );
507
508 return( CAM_SUCCESS );
509}

511static int sdmmc_attach( SIM_HBA * const hba, struct sdio_connection * const connection, sdio_device_instance_t * const instance )
512{
513 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
514 int status;
515
516 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
517 status = CAM_FAILURE;
518
519 if( sdio_attach( connection, instance, &ext->device, hba ) == EOK ) {
520 ext->instance = *instance;
521 sdio_hc_info( ext->device, &ext->hc_inf );
522 sdio_dev_info( ext->device, &ext->dev_inf );
523 ext->pm_idle_time_ns = SDMMC_TIMEOUT_MS_TO_NS( ext->hc_inf.idle_time );
524 ext->pm_sleep_time_ns = SDMMC_TIMEOUT_MS_TO_NS( ext->hc_inf.sleep_time );
525
526 sdmmc_partition_config( hba );
527
528 sdmmc_dev_cfg( hba );
529
530 status = sdmmc_reg( hba );
531 }
532
533 return( status );
534}

536static void sdmmc_sdio_insertion( struct sdio_connection * const connection, sdio_device_instance_t * const instance )
537{
538 SIM_HBA *hba;
539 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
540
541 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, sdmmc_ctrl.verbosity, 1, "%s: ", __FUNCTION__ );
542
543 if( !( sdmmc_ctrl.cflags & SDMMC_CFLAG_SCAN ) ||
544 ( sdmmc_ctrl.cflags & SDMMC_CFLAG_ENUMERATING ) ) {
545 return;
546 }
547
548 // run hba list looking for non present and instance path match or path wildcard (first insertion)
549 for( hba = TAILQ_FIRST( &sdmmc_ctrl.hlist ); hba; hba = TAILQ_NEXT( hba, hlink ) ) {
550 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
551 if( !( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_PRESENT ) ) {
552 if( ( ext->instance.path == SDIO_CONNECT_WILDCARD ) || ( ext->instance.path == instance->path ) ) {
553 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s: reuse 0x%p", __FUNCTION__, hba );
554 break;
555 }
556 }
557 }
558
559 if( hba == NULL ) {
560 hba = sdmmc_alloc_hba( );
561 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s: new 0x%p", __FUNCTION__, hba );
562 }
563
564 if( hba ) {
565 if( sdmmc_attach( hba, connection, instance ) != CAM_SUCCESS ) {
566 sdmmc_detach( hba, CAM_FALSE );
567 }
568 }
569}

571static void sdmmc_sdio_removal( struct sdio_connection * const connection, sdio_device_instance_t * const instance )
572{
573 SIM_HBA *hba;
574 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
575 struct sdio_device *device;
576
577 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, sdmmc_ctrl.verbosity, 1, "%s: ", __FUNCTION__ );
578
579 if( ( sdmmc_ctrl.cflags & SDMMC_CFLAG_ENUMERATING ) ) {
580 return;
581 }
582
583 device = sdio_device_lookup( connection, instance );
584 if( device != NULL ) {
585 hba = sdio_client_hdl( device );
586 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
587 atomic_clr( &ext->eflags, SDMMC_EFLAG_PRESENT );
588 sdmmc_detach( hba, CAM_FALSE );
589 }
590}

592__attribute__((used))
593static int sdmmc_sdio_event( struct sdio_connection * const connection, sdio_device_instance_t * const instance, const int ev )
594{
595 SIM_HBA *hba;
596 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
597 struct sdio_device *device;
598 int status;
599
600 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, sdmmc_ctrl.verbosity, 1, "%s: ", __FUNCTION__ );
601
602 status = EOK;
603
604 device = sdio_device_lookup( connection, instance );
605 if( device != NULL ) {
606 hba = sdio_client_hdl( device );
607 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
608 switch( ev ) {
609 case SDIO_EVENT_RESET:
610 if( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_ASSD ) ) {
611 atomic_set( &ext->eflags, SDMMC_EFLAG_ASSD_INIT );
612 }
613 break;
614
615 default:
616 break;
617 }
618 }
619 return( status );
620}

622static int sdmmc_post_ccb( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_SCSIIO * const ccb )
623{
624 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
625 struct timespec ts;
626
627 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
628
629 clock_gettime( CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts );
630 ext->pm_timestamp = timespec2nsec( &ts );
631
632 ext->nexus = NULL;
633
634#ifdef SDMMC_TRACE
635 sdmmc_trace_event( SDMMC_TRACE_EVENT, "%s: ccb %p", __FUNCTION__, ccb );
636#endif
637
638 if( hba->verbosity > 3 ) {
639 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s: ccb %p",__FUNCTION__, ccb );
640 }
641
642 simq_post_ccb( hba->simq, ccb );
643
644 return( CAM_SUCCESS );
645}

647int sdmmc_sense( CCB_SCSIIO * const ccb, const uint8_t sense, const uint8_t asc, const uint8_t ascq )
648{
649 SCSI_SENSE *sptr;
650
651 if( ccb->cam_ch.cam_func_code != XPT_SCSI_IO ) {
652 return( CAM_REQ_CMP_ERR );
653 }
654
655 ccb->cam_scsi_status = SCS_CHECK;
656 ccb->cam_ch.cam_status = CAM_REQ_CMP_ERR;
657 sptr = (SCSI_SENSE *)ccb->cam_sense_ptr;
658
659 if( ( sptr == NULL ) || ( ccb->cam_ch.cam_flags & CAM_DIS_AUTOSENSE ) ) {
660 return( ccb->cam_ch.cam_status );
661 }
662
663 ccb->cam_ch.cam_status |= CAM_AUTOSNS_VALID;
664
665 memset( sptr, 0, sizeof( *sptr ) );
666 sptr->error = 0x70; // Error code
667 sptr->sense = sense; // Sense key
668 sptr->asc = asc; // Additional sense code (Invalid field in CDB)
669 sptr->ascq = ascq; // Additional sense code qualifier
670
671 return( ccb->cam_ch.cam_status );
672}
673
674static int sdmmc_error( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_SCSIIO * const ccb, int status )
675{
676 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
677
678 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
679
680 switch( status ) {
681 case EIO:
682 status = sdmmc_sense( ccb, SK_MEDIUM, 0x00, 0x00 );
683 break;
684
685 case ENXIO:
686 status = sdmmc_sense( ccb, SK_NOT_RDY, ASC_MEDIA_NOT_PRESENT, 0 );
687 break;
688
689 case EACCES:
690 status = sdmmc_sense( ccb, SK_ILLEGAL, ASC_COPY_PROTECTION, ASCQ_READ_SCRAMBLED );
691 break;
692
693 case ENODEV:
694 atomic_clr( &ext->eflags, SDMMC_EFLAG_PRESENT );
695 status = CAM_NO_HBA;
696 break;
697
698 case EINVAL:
699 status = sdmmc_sense( ccb, SK_ILLEGAL, ASC_INVALID_FIELD, 0 );
700 break;
701
702 case EROFS:
703 status = sdmmc_sense( ccb, SK_DATA_PROT, ASC_WRITE_PROTECTED, ASCQ_VU_WRITE_PROTECTED );
704 break;
705
706 case ETIMEDOUT:
707 status = CAM_CMD_TIMEOUT;
708 break;
709
710 default:
711 status = CAM_REQ_CMP_ERR;
712 break;
713 }
714
715 return( status );
716}
717
718int sdmmc_unit_ready( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_SCSIIO * const ccb )
719{
720 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
721 int status;
722
723 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
724 status = CAM_REQ_CMP;
725
726 if( !( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_PRESENT ) ) {
727 status = sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, ENODEV );
728 }
729
730 if( !ext->targets[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_id].partitions[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_lun].nlba ) {
731 status = sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, ENXIO );
732 }
733
734 return( status );
735}
736
737static int sdmmc_mpage_rw_err( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_SCSIIO * const ccb, const int op )
738{
739 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
740 MODE_PARM_HEADER10 *mph;
741 int status;
742
743 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
744 mph = CAM_DATA_PTR_V( ccb->cam_data.cam_data_ptr );
745 memset( mph, 0, sizeof( MODE_PARM_HEADER10 ) );
746
747 if( op ) {
748 status = sdmmc_sense( ccb, SK_ILLEGAL, ASC_INVALID_FIELD, 0 );
749 }
750 else {
751 if( ( ext->targets[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_id].partitions[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_lun].pflags & SDMMC_PFLAG_WP ) ) {
752 mph->device_specific |= MP_DS_WP;
753 }
754 status = CAM_REQ_CMP;
755 }
756
757 return( status );
758}
759
760static int sdmmc_mpage_caching( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_SCSIIO * const ccb, const int op )
761{
762 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
763 MPAGE_CACHING *mpc;
764 MODE_PARM_HEADER10 *mph;
765 int status;
766
767 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
768 mph = CAM_DATA_PTR_V( ccb->cam_data.cam_data_ptr );
769 mpc = (MPAGE_CACHING *)(mph + 1 );
770
771 if( op ) {
772 if( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_CACHE ) ) {
773 status = sdio_cache( ext->device, ( mpc->flags & MP_CACHE_WCE ) ? SDIO_CACHE_ENABLE : SDIO_CACHE_DISABLE, SDIO_TIME_DEFAULT );
774 if( status == EOK ) {
775 status = CAM_REQ_CMP;
776 ext->eflags &= ~SDMMC_EFLAG_CACHE;
777 if( ( mpc->flags & MP_CACHE_WCE ) ) {
778 ext->eflags |= SDMMC_EFLAG_CACHE;
779 }
780 }
781 else {
782 status = sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, status );
783 }
784 }
785 else {
786 status = sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, EINVAL );
787 }
788
789 }
790 else {
791 memset( mph, 0, ccb->cam_dxfer_len );
792 mph->data_len[1] = 26;
793 mpc->pc_page = MP_CACHING;
794 mpc->page_length = 18;
795 mpc->flags = ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_CACHE ) ? MP_CACHE_WCE : 0;
796 status = CAM_REQ_CMP;
797 }
798
799 return( status );
800}

802static int sdmmc_mode_select( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_SCSIIO * const ccb )
803{
804 MPAGE_CACHING *mp;
805 MODE_PARM_HEADER10 *mph;
806 int status;
807
808 mph = CAM_DATA_PTR_V( ccb->cam_data.cam_data_ptr );
809 mp = (MPAGE_CACHING *)(mph + 1 );
810
811 switch( mp->pc_page ) {
812 case MP_CACHING:
813 status = sdmmc_mpage_caching( hba, ccb, CAM_TRUE );
814 break;
815
816 default:
817 status = sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, EINVAL );
818 break;
819 }
820
821 return( status );
822}
823
824static int sdmmc_mode_sense( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_SCSIIO * const ccb )
825{
826 int status;
827
828 status = sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, ccb );
829 if( status != CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
830 return( status );
831 }
832
833 switch( ccb->cam_cdb_io.cam_cdb_bytes[2] ) {
834 case MP_RW_ERR:
835 status = sdmmc_mpage_rw_err( hba, ccb, CAM_FALSE );
836 break;
837
838 case MP_CACHING:
839 status = sdmmc_mpage_caching( hba, ccb, CAM_FALSE );
840 break;
841
842 default:
843 status = sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, EINVAL );
844 break;
845 }
846
847 return( status );
848}

850static int sdmmc_evpd_inquiry( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_SCSIIO * const ccb )
851{
852 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
853 VPD_HEADER *vh;
854 BLOCK_LIMITS *bl;
855 BLOCK_DEVICE_CHARACTERISTICS *bdc;
856 uint8_t *vpd;
857 uint16_t lps;
858 int cstatus;
859
860 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
861
862 vpd = CAM_DATA_PTR_V( ccb->cam_data.cam_data_ptr );
863 vh = (VPD_HEADER *)vpd;
864 bl = (BLOCK_LIMITS *)(vh+1);
865 bdc = (BLOCK_DEVICE_CHARACTERISTICS *)(vh+1);
866 memset( vpd, 0, ccb->cam_dxfer_len );
867
868 cstatus = CAM_REQ_CMP;
869
870 switch( ccb->cam_cdb_io.cam_cdb_bytes[2] ) {
871 case INQ_PC_VPD_SUPPORTED: {
872 uint8_t evp_sup[] = { D_DIR_ACC, INQ_PC_VPD_SUPPORTED, 0, 3,
873 INQ_PC_VPD_SUPPORTED, INQ_PC_BLOCK_LIMITS,
874 INQ_PC_BLOCK_DEVICE_CHARACTERISTICS };
875
876 if( ccb->cam_dxfer_len < sizeof( evp_sup ) ) {
877 return( sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, EINVAL ) );
878 }
879 memcpy( vpd, evp_sup, sizeof( evp_sup ) );
880 break;
881 }
882
883 case INQ_PC_BLOCK_LIMITS:
884 if( ccb->cam_dxfer_len < ( sizeof( *vh ) + sizeof( *bl ) ) ) {
885 return( sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, EINVAL ) );
886 }
887 vh->peripheral = D_DIR_ACC;
888 vh->page_code = INQ_PC_BLOCK_LIMITS;
889 UNALIGNED_PUT16( vh->page_length, ENDIAN_BE16( 60 ) );
890
891 lps = 1;
892 UNALIGNED_PUT16( bl->optimal_xfer_len_granularity, ENDIAN_BE16( lps ) );
893
894 if( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & ( DEV_CAP_TRIM | DEV_CAP_DISCARD ) ) ) {
895 UNALIGNED_PUT32( bl->max_unmap_lba_count, ENDIAN_BE32( SDMMC_TRIM_MAX_LBA ) );
896 UNALIGNED_PUT32( bl->max_unmap_desc_count, ENDIAN_BE32( 1 ) );
897 UNALIGNED_PUT32( bl->optimal_unmap_granularity, ENDIAN_BE32( 1 ) );
898 }
899 break;
900
901 case INQ_PC_BLOCK_DEVICE_CHARACTERISTICS:
902 if( ccb->cam_dxfer_len < ( sizeof( *vh ) + sizeof( *bdc ) ) ) {
903 return( sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, EINVAL ) );
904 }
905 vh->peripheral = D_DIR_ACC;
906 vh->page_code = INQ_PC_BLOCK_DEVICE_CHARACTERISTICS;
907 UNALIGNED_PUT16( vh->page_length, ENDIAN_BE16( 60 ) );
908
909 UNALIGNED_PUT16( bdc->medium_rotation_rate, ENDIAN_BE16( 1 ) ); // 1 indicates non rotating
910 bdc->nominal_form_factor = 0;
911 break;
912
913 default:
914 return( sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, EINVAL ) );
915 break;
916 }
917
918 return( cstatus );
919}
920
921static int sdmmc_std_inquiry( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_SCSIIO * const ccb )
922{
923 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
924 SCSI_INQUIRY *iptr;
925
926 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
927 iptr = CAM_DATA_PTR_V( ccb->cam_data.cam_data_ptr );
928
929 memset( iptr, 0, sizeof( *iptr ) );
930
931 iptr->peripheral = D_DIR_ACC;
932 iptr->rmb = ( ext->hc_inf.caps & HC_CAP_SLOT_TYPE_EMBEDDED ) ? CAM_FALSE : CAM_TRUE;
933 iptr->version = INQ_VER_SPC3; // SPC-3
934 iptr->adlen = 96 - 5; // nbytes after adlen field
935
936 strlcpy( (char *)iptr->vend_id, "SDMMC:", sizeof( iptr->vend_id ) );
937 strlcpy( (char *)iptr->prod_id, (char *)ext->dev_inf.pnm, sizeof( iptr->prod_id ) );
938
939 if( ( ext->dev_inf.prv >> 4 ) < 10 ) {
940 iptr->prod_rev[0] = (uchar_t)( ( ext->dev_inf.prv >> 4 ) + '0' );
941 }
942 else {
943 iptr->prod_rev[0] = (uchar_t)( ( ext->dev_inf.prv >> 4 ) - 10 + 'a' );
944 }
945
946 iptr->prod_rev[1] = '.';
947
948 if( ( ext->dev_inf.prv & 0x0F) < 10 ) {
949 iptr->prod_rev[2] = (uchar_t)( ( ext->dev_inf.prv & 0x0F ) + '0' );
950 }
951 else {
952 iptr->prod_rev[2] = (uchar_t) ( ( ext->dev_inf.prv & 0x0F ) - 10 + 'a' );
953 }
954
955 if( ccb->cam_dxfer_len > 56 ) { // check len for vend_spc
956 strlcpy( (char *)iptr->vend_spc, ext->targets[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_id].partitions[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_lun].name, sizeof( iptr->vend_spc ) );
957 }
958
959 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
960}
961
962static int sdmmc_inquiry( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_SCSIIO * const ccb )
963{
964 int status;
965
966 if( ( ccb->cam_cdb_io.cam_cdb_bytes[1] & INQ_OPT_EVPD ) ) {
967 status = sdmmc_evpd_inquiry( hba, ccb );
968 }
969 else {
970 status = sdmmc_std_inquiry( hba, ccb );
971 }
972
973 return( status );
974}

976static int sdmmc_spindle( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_SCSIIO * const ccb )
977{
978 int status;
979
980 status = sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, ccb );
981 if( status != CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
982 return( status );
983 }
984
985 switch( ccb->cam_cdb_io.cam_cdb_bytes[4] ) {
986 case LD_CMD_STOP:
987 case LD_CMD_START:
988 status = CAM_REQ_CMP;
989 break;
990
991 case LD_CMD_EJECT:
992 case LD_CMD_LOAD:
993 default:
994 status = sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, EINVAL );
995 break;
996 }
997 return( status );
998}

1000static int sdmmc_capacity( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_SCSIIO *ccb, const int action )
1001{
1002 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
1003 SDMMC_TARGET *targ;
1004 READ_CAPACITY *cp;
1005 READ_CAPACITY16 *cp16;
1006 uint64_t lba;
1007 int status;
1008 void *dptr;
1009 uint32_t la;
1010 uint32_t lps;
1011
1012 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
1013 dptr = CAM_DATA_PTR_V( ccb->cam_data.cam_data_ptr );
1014 targ = &ext->targets[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_id];
1015
1016 // the capacity returned is the last addressable lba, thus the nlba - 1
1017 lba = targ->partitions[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_lun].nlba - 1;
1018
1019 status = sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, ccb );
1020 if( status != CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
1021 return( status );
1022 }
1023
1024 ccb->cam_ch.cam_status = CAM_REQ_CMP;
1025 ccb->cam_scsi_status = SCS_GOOD;
1026
1027 if( action == SAI_READ_CAPACITY_16 ) {
1028 cp16 = dptr;
1029 cp16->lba = ENDIAN_BE64( lba ); // Returned logical block address
1030 cp16->blk_size = ENDIAN_BE32( targ->blksz );
1031
1032 la = 0;
1033 lps = 0;
1034 cp16->exponents = lps;
1035 cp16->tp_lalba[0] = la >> 8;
1036 cp16->tp_lalba[1] = la;
1037 if( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_TRIM ) ) {
1038 cp16->tp_lalba[0] |= RD_CAP_TPE;
1039 }
1040 }
1041 else {
1042 cp = dptr;
1043 if( lba >= RD_CAP_MAX_LBA32 ) {
1044 cp->lba = ENDIAN_BE32( RD_CAP_MAX_LBA32 ); // Returned logical block address
1045 }
1046 else {
1047 cp->lba = ENDIAN_BE32( lba ); // Returned logical block address
1048 }
1049 cp->blk_size = ENDIAN_BE32( targ->blksz );
1050 }
1051
1052 return( status );
1053}
1054
1055static int sdmmc_write_same( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_SCSIIO *ccb )
1056{
1057 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
1058 CDB *cdb;
1059 SDMMC_PARTITION *part;
1060 uint64_t lba;
1061 uint32_t nlba;
1062 int status;
1063
1064 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
1065 cdb = cam_cdb( ccb );
1066 status = CAM_REQ_CMP;
1067 part = &ext->targets[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_id].partitions[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_lun];
1068 lba = ENDIAN_BE64( UNALIGNED_RET64( cdb->write_same16.lba ) );
1069 nlba = ENDIAN_BE32( UNALIGNED_RET32( cdb->write_same16.transfer_len ) );
1070 lba += part->slba;
1071
1072 status = sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, ccb );
1073 if( status != CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
1074 return( status );
1075 }
1076
1077 if( !( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_TRIM ) || !( cdb->write_same16.opt & WS_OPT_UNMAP ) ) {
1078 status = sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, EINVAL );
1079 }
1080 else if( ( status = sdio_erase( ext->device, part->config, MMC_ERASE_TRIM, lba, nlba ) ) ) {
1081 status = sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, status );
1082 }
1083 else {
1084 // nothing
1085 }
1086
1087 if( status == EOK ) {
1088 part->tc += nlba;
1089 }
1090
1091 return( status ? status : CAM_REQ_CMP );
1092}
1093
1094static int sdmmc_erase12( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_SCSIIO *ccb )
1095{
1096 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
1097 CDB *cdb;
1098 SDMMC_PARTITION *part;
1099 uint32_t lba;
1100 uint32_t nlba;
1101 uint32_t egs;
1102 uint32_t pend;
1103 int status;
1104
1105 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
1106 cdb = cam_cdb( ccb );
1107 part = &ext->targets[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_id].partitions[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_lun];
1108
1109 egs = ext->dev_inf.erase_size / 512;
1110 lba = ENDIAN_BE32( UNALIGNED_RET32( cdb->erase12.lba ) );
1111 nlba = ENDIAN_BE32( UNALIGNED_RET32( cdb->erase12.transfer_len ) );
1112 lba += part->slba;
1113 pend = part->slba + part->nlba - 1;
1114
1115 status = sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, ccb );
1116 if( status == CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
1117 if( ( lba > pend ) || ( ( lba + nlba - 1 ) > pend ) ||
1118 ( lba % egs ) || ( nlba % egs ) ) {
1119 status = sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, EINVAL );
1120 }
1121 else if( ( status = sdio_erase( ext->device, part->config, MMC_ERASE_SECURE, lba, nlba ) ) ) {
1122 status = sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, status );
1123 }
1124 else {
1125 // nothing
1126 }
1127 }
1128
1129 if( status == EOK ) {
1130 part->ec += nlba;
1131 }
1132
1133 return( status ? status : CAM_REQ_CMP );
1134}
1135
1136static int sdmmc_ffu( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_SCSIIO *ccb )
1137{
1138 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
1139 SDMMC_PARTITION *part;
1140 sdio_ecsd_t *ecsd;
1141 CDB *cdb;
1142 uint32_t sgc;
1143 sdio_sge_t *sgp;
1144 sdio_sge_t sge;
1145 uint32_t flgs;
1146 int status;
1147 uint8_t *rawecsd;
1148 uint16_t dssize; // firmware download data sector size
1149
1150 flgs = SCF_DIR_OUT;
1151 cdb = cam_cdb( ccb );
1152 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
1153 part = &ext->targets[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_id].partitions[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_lun];
1154 ecsd = sdio_get_ecsd( ext->device );
1155 rawecsd = sdio_get_raw_ecsd( ext->device );
1156
1157 if( ( ext->instance.ident.dtype != DEV_TYPE_MMC ) || ( rawecsd[ECSD_REV] < ECSD_REV_V5 ) ||
1158 !( rawecsd[ECSD_SUPPORTED_MODES] & ECSD_FFU_SUPPORTED ) ) {
1159 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: the device doesn't support FFU!", __func__ );
1160 return( ENOTSUP );
1161 }
1162
1163 if( rawecsd[ECSD_FW_CONFIG] & ECSD_FWUPDATE_DISABLED ) {
1164 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: FFU is disabled!", __func__ );
1165 return EPERM;
1166 }
1167
1168 // Only support 0x0F(active microcode) and 0x04(download microcode)
1169 if( ( cdb->write_buffer.mode != WB_MODE_DNLD_MC ) && ( cdb->write_buffer.mode != WB_MODE_ACT_MC ) ) {
1170 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: Invalid FFU mode:%d!", __func__, cdb->write_buffer.mode );
1171 return( EINVAL );
1172 }
1173
1174 status = sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, ccb );
1175 if( status != CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
1176 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: Unit not ready!", __func__ );
1177 return( EBUSY );
1178 }
1179
1180 // Active firmware
1181 if( cdb->write_buffer.mode == WB_MODE_ACT_MC ) {
1182 if( ( rawecsd[ECSD_FFU_FEATURE] & ECSD_FFU_OPCODE_SUPPORTED ) ) {
1183 status = sdio_mmc_switch( ext->device, MMC_SWITCH_CMDSET_DFLT,
1184 MMC_SWITCH_MODE_WRITE, ECSD_MODE_OPERATION_CODES, ECSD_FFU_INSTALL, SDIO_TIME_DEFAULT );
1185 }
1186 else {
1187 status = sdio_mmc_switch( ext->device, MMC_SWITCH_CMDSET_DFLT,
1188 MMC_SWITCH_MODE_WRITE, ECSD_MODE_CONFIG, ECSD_MODE_NORMAL, SDIO_TIME_DEFAULT );
1189 }
1190
1191 sdmmc_reset( hba );
1192
1193 return( status ? status : CAM_REQ_CMP );
1194 }
1195
1196 // Firmware download
1197 // Enter FFU mode for the first data chunk
1198 if( cdb->write_buffer.buffer_id == 0 ) {
1199 // Flush cache
1200 if( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_CACHE ) && ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_CACHE ) ) {
1201 status = sdio_cache( ext->device, SDIO_CACHE_FLUSH, SDIO_TIME_DEFAULT * 5 );
1202 if( status != EOK ) {
1203 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: Error Cache Flush", __FUNCTION__ );
1204 return( status );
1205 }
1206 }
1207
1208 // Switch off Device BKOPS (eMMC 5.1)
1209 if( ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_BKOPS_AUTO ) ) {
1210 status = sdmmc_bkops_cfg( hba, CAM_FALSE );
1211 if( status != EOK ) {
1212 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: Error Disabling auto BKOPS", __FUNCTION__ );
1213 return( status );
1214 }
1215 }
1216
1217 // Enter FFU mode
1218 status = sdio_mmc_switch( ext->device, MMC_SWITCH_CMDSET_DFLT,
1219 MMC_SWITCH_MODE_WRITE, ECSD_MODE_CONFIG, ECSD_MODE_FFU, SDIO_TIME_DEFAULT );
1220 if( status != EOK ) {
1221 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: Enter FFU mode failed", __FUNCTION__ );
1222 return( status );
1223 }
1224 }
1225
1226 // Download firmware
1227 dssize = ( rawecsd[ECSD_DATA_SECTOR_SIZE] == ECSD_NATIVE_SECTOR_4K ) ? 4096 : 512;
1228 if( ( ccb->cam_dxfer_len == 0 ) || ( ( ccb->cam_dxfer_len % dssize ) != 0 ) ) {
1229 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: Invalid data length %d", __func__, ccb->cam_dxfer_len );
1230 return( EINVAL );
1231 }
1232
1233 // Set firmware download sector size
1234 if( ext->dev_inf.sector_size != dssize ) {
1235 status = sdio_set_block_length( ext->device, dssize );
1236 if( status != EOK ) {
1237 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: Failed to set block length %d", __func__, dssize );
1238 return( EIO );
1239 }
1240 ext->dev_inf.sector_size = dssize;
1241 }
1242
1243 if( ( ccb->cam_ch.cam_flags & CAM_SCATTER_VALID ) ) {
1244 sgc = ccb->cam_sglist_cnt;
1245 sgp = (sdio_sge_t *)ccb->cam_data.cam_sg_ptr;
1246 }
1247 else {
1248 sgc = 1;
1249 sgp = &sge;
1250 sgp->sg_count = ccb->cam_dxfer_len;
1251 sgp->sg_address = ccb->cam_data.cam_data_ptr;
1252 }
1253
1254 if( ( ccb->cam_ch.cam_flags & CAM_DATA_PHYS ) ) {
1255 flgs |= SCF_DATA_PHYS;
1256 }
1257
1258 // Write firmware data
1259 status = sdmmc_rw( hba, part, flgs, UNALIGNED_RET32( &rawecsd[ECSD_FFU_ARG] ),
1260 ccb->cam_dxfer_len, sgp, sgc, ccb->cam_req_map, ccb->cam_timeout );
1261
1262 ext->dev_inf.sector_size = ecsd->blksz;
1263
1264 return( status ? status : CAM_REQ_CMP );
1265}
1266
1267static int sdmmc_cache_flush( SIM_HBA * const hba )
1268{
1269 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
1270 int status;
1271
1272 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
1273 status = EOK;
1274
1275 if( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_CACHE ) && ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_CACHE ) && ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_VCACHE_DIRTY ) ) {
1276 status = sdio_cache( ext->device, SDIO_CACHE_FLUSH, SDIO_TIME_DEFAULT * 5 );
1277 if( status == EOK ) {
1278 ext->eflags &= ~SDMMC_EFLAG_VCACHE_DIRTY; // clear dirty flag
1279 }
1280 }
1281 return( status );
1282}
1283
1284static int sdmmc_sync( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_SCSIIO * const ccb )
1285{
1286 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
1287 int status;
1288
1289 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
1290
1291 if( !( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_PRESENT ) ) {
1292 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
1293 }
1294
1295 status = sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, ccb );
1296 if( status == CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
1297 if( ( status = sdmmc_cache_flush( hba ) ) ) {
1298 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 0, 0, "%s: sdmmc_cache_flush Failure %d", __FUNCTION__, status );
1299 }
1300 }
1301
1302 return( status ? status : CAM_REQ_CMP );
1303}
1304
1305static int sdmmc_timer_settime( const int tid, const uint64_t nsec, const int repeat )
1306{
1307 struct timespec ts;
1308 struct itimerspec value;
1309
1310 memset( &value, 0, sizeof( value ) );
1311
1312 if( nsec ) {
1313 nsec2timespec( &ts, nsec );
1314 value.it_value = ts;
1315 if( repeat ) {
1316 value.it_interval.tv_sec = ts.tv_sec;
1317 value.it_interval.tv_nsec = ts.tv_nsec;
1318 }
1319 }
1320
1321 if( timer_settime( tid, 0, &value, NULL ) == -1 ) {
1322 return( errno );
1323 }
1324
1325 return( EOK );
1326}
1327
1328static int sdmmc_pm( SIM_HBA * const hba, uint32_t op )
1329{
1330 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
1331
1332 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
1333
1334 if( ext->pm_state == op ) {
1335 return( EOK );
1336 }
1337
1338#if 0
1339{
1340 static const char *name[4] = { "idle", "active", "sleep", "suspend" };
1341 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s: %s", __FUNCTION__, name[op] );
1342}
1343#endif
1344
1345 switch( op ) {
1346 case PM_IDLE:
1347 sdio_pwrmgnt( ext->device, PM_IDLE );
1348 if( ( ext->hc_inf.caps & HC_CAP_SLEEP ) ) {
1349 sdmmc_timer_settime( ext->pm_timerid, ext->pm_sleep_time_ns, CAM_FALSE );
1350 }
1351 else {
1352 sdmmc_timer_settime( ext->pm_timerid, 0, CAM_FALSE );
1353 }
1354 break;
1355
1356 case PM_SLEEP:
1357 sdmmc_timer_settime( ext->pm_timerid, 0, CAM_FALSE );
1358 if( sdio_pwrmgnt( ext->device, PM_SLEEP ) ) { // sleep failed, re-arm timer, back to idle
1359 op = PM_IDLE;
1360 sdmmc_timer_settime( ext->pm_timerid, ext->pm_sleep_time_ns, CAM_FALSE );
1361 }
1362 break;
1363
1364 case PM_ACTIVE:
1365 if( ( ext->pm_state == PM_SLEEP ) || ( ext->pm_state == PM_SUSPEND ) ) {
1366 if( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_ASSD ) ) {
1367 atomic_set( &ext->eflags, SDMMC_EFLAG_ASSD_INIT );
1368 }
1369 }
1370 sdmmc_timer_settime( ext->pm_timerid, ext->pm_idle_time_ns, CAM_TRUE );
1371 sdio_pwrmgnt( ext->device, PM_ACTIVE );
1372 break;
1373
1374 case PM_SUSPEND:
1375 sdmmc_timer_settime( ext->pm_timerid, 0, CAM_FALSE ); // stop PM timer
1376 sdio_pwrmgnt( ext->device, PM_SUSPEND );
1377 break;
1378
1379 default:
1380 return( EINVAL );
1381 }
1382
1383 ext->pm_state = op;
1384
1385 return( EOK );
1386}
1387
1388static int sdmmc_set_partition_attr( SIM_HBA * const hba, const uint32_t partition, const uint32_t flags )
1389{
1390 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
1391 SDMMC_TARGET *targ;
1392 SDMMC_PARTITION *part;
1393 uint32_t pidx;
1394 uint32_t tidx;
1395
1396 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
1397
1398 for( tidx = 0; tidx <= ext->ntargs; tidx++ ) {
1399 targ = &ext->targets[tidx];
1400 for( pidx = 0; pidx <= targ->nluns; pidx++ ) {
1401 part = &targ->partitions[pidx];
1402 if( ( part->config & MMC_PART_MSK ) == partition ) {
1403 part->pflags |= flags;
1404 }
1405 }
1406 }
1407 return( CAM_SUCCESS );
1408}
1409
1410int sdmmc_reset( SIM_HBA * const hba )
1411{
1412 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
1413
1414 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
1415
1416 sdio_reset( ext->device );
1417
1418 if( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_CACHE ) && ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_CACHE ) ) {
1419 // Mark device user partition as read only/write protected after a reset when eMMC cache is enabled.
1420 // This is done since we don't know if there was pending data in the eMMC cache.
1421 if( ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_VCACHE_DIRTY ) ) {
1422 sdmmc_set_partition_attr( hba, MMC_PART_USER, SDMMC_PFLAG_WP );
1423 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: sdio_reset cache lost - device marked read only", __FUNCTION__ );
1424 }
1425 else {
1426 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: sdio_reset - disabling volatile cache", __FUNCTION__ );
1427 }
1428 ext->eflags &= ~SDMMC_EFLAG_CACHE;
1429 }
1430
1431 sdmmc_dev_cfg( hba );
1432
1433 return( EOK );
1434}
1435
1436int sdmmc_bkops_cfg( SIM_HBA * const hba, const int op )
1437{
1438 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
1439 int status;
1440 int bkop;
1441
1442 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
1443 bkop = 0;
1444
1445 if( !( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_BKOPS ) ) {
1446 return( ENOTSUP );
1447 }
1448
1449 if( ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_BKOPS ) ) {
1450 // set manual bkops if enabled (WARNING: permanent setting)
1451 bkop = ECSD_BKOPS_ENABLE;
1452 }
1453
1454 if( op ) {
1455 if( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_BKOPS_AUTO ) && ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_BKOPS_AUTO ) ) {
1456 bkop |= ECSD_BKOPS_AUTO_EN; // set bkops auto
1457 }
1458 }
1459
1460 status = sdio_mmc_switch( ext->device, MMC_SWITCH_CMDSET_DFLT, MMC_SWITCH_MODE_WRITE, ECSD_BKOPS_EN, bkop, SDIO_TIME_DEFAULT );
1461 if( status != EOK ) {
1462 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: sdio_mmc_switch ECSD_BKOPS_EN - 0x%x, status %d", __FUNCTION__, bkop, status );
1463 }
1464
1465 return( status );
1466}
1467
1468int sdmmc_bkops( SIM_HBA * const hba, const int tick )
1469{
1470 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
1471 int status = EOK;
1472 uint8_t ecsd[MMC_EXT_CSD_SIZE];
1473
1474 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
1475
1476 if( !( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_BKOPS ) || ( ext->drvr_state == SDMMC_DRVR_PAUSE ) ) {
1477 return( EOK );
1478 }
1479
1480 if( ( ext->bkops_status & BKOPS_STATUS_OPERATIONS_INPROG ) ) {
1481 sdmmc_pm( hba, PM_ACTIVE );
1482 if( !tick ) {
1483 // wait up to 1/2 second to complete
1484 status = sdio_hpi( ext->device, 500 );
1485 if( status ) {
1486 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s(%d): HPI failure", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__ );
1487 sdmmc_reset( hba );
1488 }
1489 ext->bkops_status = BKOPS_STATUS_OPERATIONS_NONE;
1490 }
1491 return( status );
1492 }
1493
1494 if( tick ) { // Timer event, poll status
1495 sdmmc_pm( hba, PM_ACTIVE );
1496
1497 if( ext->bkops_status ) {
1498 ext->bkops_ticks++;
1499 }
1500
1501 if( sdio_send_ext_csd( ext->device, ecsd ) == EOK ) {
1502 if( ext->bkops_status != ecsd[ECSD_BKOPS_STATUS] ) {
1503 ext->bkops_ticks = 0;
1504 ext->bkops_status = ecsd[ECSD_BKOPS_STATUS];
1505 }
1506 }
1507 }
1508
1509 switch( ext->bkops_status ) {
1510 case BKOPS_STATUS_OPERATIONS_NONE:
1511 break;
1512
1513 case BKOPS_STATUS_OPERATIONS_NON_CRITICAL:
1514 if( ext->bkops_ticks < BKOPS_NC_TICKS ) {
1515 break;
1516 }
1517
1518 // fall through
1519
1520 case BKOPS_STATUS_OPERATIONS_IMPACTED:
1521 if( ext->bkops_ticks < BKOPS_IMPACTED_TICKS ) {
1522 break;
1523 }
1524
1525 // fall through
1526
1527 case BKOPS_STATUS_OPERATIONS_CRITICAL:
1528 // Should we wait when critial is detected via timer tick?
1529 // if( ext->bkops_status == BKOPS_STATUS_OPERATIONS_CRITICAL ) {
1530 // tick = 0;
1531 // }
1532
1533 // We could make the completion time shorter and use hpi. Will the chip take new requests while critical?
1534 status = sdio_mmc_switch( ext->device, MMC_SWITCH_CMDSET_DFLT, MMC_SWITCH_MODE_WRITE,
1535 ECSD_BKOPS_START, ECSD_BKOPS_INITIATE, tick ? 0 : SDMMC_TIME_BKOPS );
1536 if( status != EOK ) {
1537 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s(%d): BKOPS switch failed status 0x%x", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, status );
1538 if( status == ETIMEDOUT ) {
1539 if( ( status = sdio_hpi( ext->device, 0 ) ) ) {
1540 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s(%d): HPI failure status 0x%x", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, status );
1541 sdmmc_reset( hba );
1542 }
1543 }
1544 else {
1545 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s(%d): BKOPS_START failure status 0x%x", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, status );
1546 }
1547 }
1548 else {
1549 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s(%d): BKOPS_START BKOPS_STATUS_OPERATIONS_INPROG", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__ );
1550 ext->bkops_status |= BKOPS_STATUS_OPERATIONS_INPROG;
1551 ext->bkops_ticks = 0;
1552 }
1553 break;
1554
1555 default:
1556 break;
1557 }
1558
1559 return( EOK );
1560}
1561
1562static int sdmmc_write_protect( SIM_HBA * const hba, const uint32_t op, const uint32_t partition, const uint32_t mode, uint64_t lba, uint32_t nlba, uint64_t *prot )
1563{
1564 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
1565 struct sdio_device *dev;
1566 struct sdio_cmd *cmd;
1567 sdio_sge_t sge;
1568 uint8_t *ecsd;
1569 int sz;
1570 int blksz;
1571 int status;
1572 void *pdata;
1573 uint8_t pmode;
1574 uint64_t addr;
1575 uint64_t wp_grp_size;
1576
1577 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
1578 dev = ext->device;
1579 blksz = ext->dev_inf.sector_size;
1580 wp_grp_size = ext->dev_inf.wp_size / 512;
1581 sz = MMC_SEND_WRITE_PROT_SIZE;
1582 ecsd = sdio_get_raw_ecsd( ext->device );
1583
1584 if( !wp_grp_size ) {
1585 return( ENOTSUP );
1586 }
1587
1588 if( ( lba % wp_grp_size ) ) {
1589 return( EINVAL );
1590 }
1591
1592 status = sdio_set_partition( dev, partition );
1593 if( status != EOK ) {
1594 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: sdio_set_partition failure %s", __FUNCTION__, strerror( status ) );
1595 return( status );
1596 }
1597
1598 if( op == MMC_SET_WRITE_PROT ) {
1599 switch( ( partition & MMC_PART_MSK ) ) {
1600 case MMC_PART_USER:
1601 if( ( mode & SDMMC_WP_MODE_PWR_WP_EN ) ) { // Power-on
1602 pmode = ecsd[ECSD_USER_WP] & ~( ECSD_USER_WP_US_PWR_WP_EN | ECSD_USER_WP_US_PERM_WP_EN | ECSD_USER_WP_US_PWR_WP_DIS );
1603 pmode |= mode;
1604 }
1605 else { // Temporary
1606 pmode = ecsd[ECSD_USER_WP] & ~( ECSD_USER_WP_US_PWR_WP_EN | ECSD_USER_WP_US_PERM_WP_EN );
1607 }
1608
1609 status = sdio_mmc_switch( dev, MMC_SWITCH_CMDSET_DFLT, MMC_SWITCH_MODE_WRITE, ECSD_USER_WP, pmode, SDIO_TIME_DEFAULT );
1610 if( status != EOK ) {
1611 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: switch ext_csd_user_wp mode %d, user_wp 0x%x", __FUNCTION__, pmode, ecsd[ECSD_USER_WP] );
1612 return( status );
1613 }
1614 break;
1615
1616 case MMC_PART_BOOT1:
1617 case MMC_PART_BOOT2:
1618 status = sdio_mmc_switch( dev, MMC_SWITCH_CMDSET_DFLT, MMC_SWITCH_MODE_WRITE, ECSD_BOOT_WP, mode, SDIO_TIME_DEFAULT );
1619 if( status != EOK ) {
1620 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: switch ext_csd_boot_wp", __FUNCTION__ );
1621 return( status );
1622 }
1623 break;
1624
1625 default:
1626 return( EINVAL );
1627 }
1628 }
1629
1630 cmd = sdio_alloc_cmd( );
1631 if( cmd == NULL ) {
1632 return( ENOMEM );
1633 }
1634
1635 switch( op ) {
1636 case MMC_SET_WRITE_PROT:
1637 case MMC_CLR_WRITE_PROT:
1638 while( nlba ) {
1639 addr = ( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_HC ) != 0 ) ? lba : ( lba * blksz );
1640 sdio_setup_cmd( cmd, SCF_CTYPE_AC | SCF_RSP_R1B | SCF_WAIT_DRDY, op, (uint32_t)addr );
1641 status = sdio_send_cmd( dev, cmd, NULL, SDMMC_TIME_DEFAULT * 1000, 0 );
1642 if( status != EOK ) {
1643 break;
1644 }
1645
1646 lba += wp_grp_size;
1647 nlba -= min( nlba, wp_grp_size );
1648 }
1649 break;
1650
1651 case MMC_SEND_WRITE_PROT:
1652 case MMC_SEND_WRITE_PROT_TYPE:
1653 addr = ( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_HC ) != 0 ) ? lba : ( lba * blksz );
1654 if( ( op == MMC_SEND_WRITE_PROT_TYPE ) && ( ext->dev_inf.spec_rev >= ECSD_REV_V4_41 ) ) {
1655 sz = MMC_SEND_WRITE_PROT_TYPE_SIZE;
1656 }
1657
1658 pdata = sdio_alloc( sz );
1659 if( pdata == NULL ) {
1660 status = ENOMEM;
1661 break;
1662 }
1663
1664 sge.sg_count = sz;
1665 sge.sg_address = CAM_DATA_PTR_P( pdata );
1666 sdio_setup_cmd( cmd, SCF_CTYPE_ADTC | SCF_RSP_R1, op, (uint32_t)addr );
1667 sdio_setup_cmd_io( cmd, SCF_DIR_IN, 1, sz, &sge, 1, NULL );
1668 status = sdio_send_cmd( dev, cmd, NULL, SDMMC_TIME_DEFAULT * 1000, 0 );
1669 if( status == EOK ) {
1670 *prot = ( sz == 4 ) ? ENDIAN_BE32( *(uint32_t *)pdata ) :
1671 ENDIAN_BE64( *(uint64_t *)pdata );
1672 }
1673
1674 sdio_free( pdata, sz );
1675 break;
1676
1677 default:
1678 status = EINVAL;
1679 break;
1680 }
1681
1682 sdio_free_cmd( cmd );
1683
1684 return( status );
1685}
1686
1687int sdmmc_rw( SIM_HBA * const hba, SDMMC_PARTITION *part, uint32_t flgs, uint64_t addr, const uint32_t dlen, sdio_sge_t * const sgl, const uint32_t sgc, void * const mhdl, uint32_t timeout )
1688{
1689 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
1690 struct sdio_cmd *cmd;
1691 sdio_dev_info_t *di;
1692 struct sdio_device *dev;
1693 int rst;
1694 uint32_t op;
1695 uint32_t blks;
1696 uint32_t blksz;
1697 int status;
1698 int bus_err;
1699 uint32_t cstatus;
1700 uint32_t rsp[4];
1701
1702 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
1703 dev = ext->device;
1704 di = &ext->dev_inf;
1705
1706 rst = CAM_FALSE;
1707 bus_err = CAM_FALSE;
1708 timeout *= 1000;
1709 blksz = di->sector_size;
1710 blks = dlen / blksz;
1711 addr = ( ( di->caps & DEV_CAP_HC ) != 0 ) ? addr : ( addr * blksz );
1712 op = ( flgs & SCF_DIR_IN ) ? MMC_READ_SINGLE_BLOCK : MMC_WRITE_BLOCK;
1713
1714 if( dlen > blksz ) {
1715 if( !( ext->hc_inf.caps & HC_CAP_ACMD12 ) ) {
1716 if( ( di->caps & DEV_CAP_CMD23 ) ) {
1717 flgs |= SCF_SBC;
1718 }
1719 }
1720 flgs |= SCF_MULTIBLK;
1721 }
1722
1723 if( ( flgs & SCF_SBC_RLW ) ) {
1724 flgs |= SCF_SBC | SCF_MULTIBLK; // reliable write requires set block and write multiple commands
1725 }
1726
1727 if( ( flgs & SCF_MULTIBLK ) ) {
1728 op++;
1729 }
1730
1731 if( addr > SC_RW_MAX_LBA32 ) {
1732 flgs |= SCF_SUA;
1733 }
1734
1735 cmd = sdio_alloc_cmd( );
1736 if( cmd == NULL ) {
1737 return( ENOMEM );
1738 }
1739
1740 sdio_setup_cmd_ext( cmd, SCF_CTYPE_ADTC | SCF_RSP_R1, op, (uint32_t)addr, (uint32_t)( addr >> 32 ) );
1741 sdio_setup_cmd_io( cmd, flgs, blks, blksz, sgl, sgc, mhdl );
1742 status = sdio_send_cmd( dev, cmd, NULL, timeout, 0 );
1743 sdio_cmd_status( cmd, &cstatus, rsp );
1744 sdio_free_cmd( cmd );
1745
1746 if( status ) {
1747 if( status == ENXIO ) { // card has been removed
1748 return( status );
1749 }
1750
1751 if( sdio_send_status( dev, rsp, 0 ) || ( ( rsp[0] & ( CDS_READY_FOR_DATA | CDS_CUR_STATE_MSK ) ) != ( CDS_READY_FOR_DATA | CDS_CUR_STATE_TRAN ) ) ) {
1752 if( sdio_stop_transmission( dev, 0 ) ) {
1753 status = ETIMEDOUT;
1754 }
1755 }
1756 }
1757 else {
1758 if( ( flgs & SCF_MULTIBLK ) ) {
1759 if( ( !( flgs & SCF_SBC ) && ( dlen > blksz ) && !( ext->hc_inf.caps & HC_CAP_ACMD12 ) ) ) {
1760 if( sdio_stop_transmission( dev, 0 ) ) {
1761 status = ETIMEDOUT;
1762 }
1763 }
1764 }
1765
1766 if( ( status == EOK ) && ( flgs & SCF_DIR_OUT ) ) {
1767 status = sdio_wait_card_status( dev, rsp, CDS_READY_FOR_DATA | CDS_CUR_STATE_MSK, CDS_READY_FOR_DATA | CDS_CUR_STATE_TRAN, timeout );
1768 if( status != EOK ) {
1769 sdio_stop_transmission( dev, 0 );
1770 }
1771 }
1772
1773 // don't update counts for RPMB
1774 if( ( part->config & MMC_PART_MSK ) != MMC_PART_RPMB ) {
1775 if( ( flgs & SCF_DIR_IN ) ) {
1776 part->rc += blks;
1777 }
1778 else {
1779 part->wc += blks;
1780 }
1781 }
1782 }
1783
1784 switch( cstatus ) {
1785 case CS_CMD_CMP:
1786 break;
1787
1788 case CS_CMD_TO_ERR:
1789 case CS_CMD_CRC_ERR:
1790 case CS_CMD_END_ERR:
1791 status = ETIMEDOUT; // set timeout so CAM layer will retry
1792 break;
1793
1794
1795 case CS_DATA_TO_ERR:
1796 status = ETIMEDOUT;
1797 break;
1798
1799 case CS_DATA_CRC_ERR:
1800 case CS_DATA_END_ERR:
1801 bus_err = CAM_TRUE;
1802 status = ETIMEDOUT;
1803 break;
1804
1805 default:
1806 status = ETIMEDOUT;
1807 break;
1808 }
1809
1810 if( rsp[0] ) {
1811 if( ( rsp[0] & CDS_URGENT_BKOPS ) ) {
1812 ext->bkops_status = ECSD_BS_OPERATIONS_CRITICAL;
1813 }
1814 if( ( rsp[0] & CDS_ERROR ) ) {
1815 status = EIO;
1816 }
1817 if( ( rsp[0] & CDS_WP_VIOLATION ) ) {
1818 status = EROFS;
1819 }
1820 if( ( rsp[0] & CDS_CARD_IS_LOCKED ) ) {
1821 status = EACCES;
1822 }
1823 if( ( rsp[0] & CDS_CARD_ECC_FAILED ) ) {
1824 status = EIO;
1825 }
1826 }
1827
1828 if( status ) {
1829 // reset when we are not ready for data and in the transfer state
1830 if( rst || sdio_send_status( dev, rsp, 0 ) || ( rsp[0] & ( CDS_READY_FOR_DATA | CDS_CUR_STATE_MSK ) ) != ( CDS_READY_FOR_DATA | CDS_CUR_STATE_TRAN ) ) {
1831 sdmmc_reset( hba );
1832 }
1833
1834 if( bus_err && ( ext->instance.ident.dtype == DEV_TYPE_SD ) ) { // inform sdio layer of bus error (layer will reduce transfer mode after 2 errors).
1835 sdio_bus_error( ext->device );
1836 }
1837
1838 sdio_dev_info( ext->device, &ext->dev_inf ); // device info may have been updated after bus_err or reset
1839
1840 if( ( status == ETIMEDOUT ) && ( flgs & SCF_SBC ) ) {
1841 // some SD cards have buggy firmware and will
1842 // hang when pre-defined block counts are used
1843 if( ext->instance.ident.dtype == DEV_TYPE_SD ) {
1844 di->caps &= ~DEV_CAP_CMD23;
1845 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: disable CMD23", __FUNCTION__ );
1846 }
1847 }
1848
1849 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: flgs 0x%x, lba %"PRIu64", len %d, status 0x%x, cstatus 0x%x, rsp[0] 0x%x",
1850 __FUNCTION__, flgs, addr, dlen, status, cstatus, rsp[0] );
1851 }
1852
1853 return( status );
1854}
1855
1856#ifdef SDMMC_WRITE_VERIFY
1857int sdmmc_write_verify( SIM_HBA *hba, CCB_SCSIIO *ccb )
1858{
1859 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
1860 SDMMC_PARTITION *part;
1861 uint32_t lba;
1862 int status;
1863 int sgc;
1864 sdio_sge_t wsgp;
1865 sdio_sge_t *sgp;
1866 sdio_sge_t sge;
1867 int verification;
1868
1869 char *rptr;
1870 char *wptr;
1871
1872 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
1873 part = &ext->targets[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_id].partitions[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_lun];
1874 lba = ENDIAN_BE32( UNALIGNED_RET32( &ccb->cam_cdb_io.cam_cdb_bytes[2] ) );
1875
1876 if( part->blk_shft ) {
1877 lba <<= part->blk_shft;
1878 }
1879
1880 lba += part->slba;
1881
1882 if( ( ccb->cam_ch.cam_flags & CAM_SCATTER_VALID ) ) {
1883 sgc = ccb->cam_sglist_cnt;
1884 sgp = (sdio_sge_t *)ccb->cam_data.cam_sg_ptr;
1885 }
1886 else {
1887 sgc = 1;
1888 sgp = &sge;
1889 sgp->sg_count = ccb->cam_dxfer_len;
1890 sgp->sg_address = ccb->cam_data.cam_data_ptr;
1891 }
1892
1893 verification = CAM_SUCCESS;
1894 rptr = (char *)ext->ver_vaddr;
1895 wsgp.sg_count = ccb->cam_dxfer_len;
1896 wsgp.sg_address = ext->ver_paddr;
1897
1898 if( ccb->cam_dxfer_len > SDMMC_VER_BSIZE ) {
1899 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: request too large (%d)", __FUNCTION__, ccb->cam_dxfer_len );
1900 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
1901 }
1902
1903 status = sdmmc_rw( hba, part, SCF_DIR_IN | SCF_DATA_PHYS, lba, ccb->cam_dxfer_len, &wsgp, 1, NULL, ccb->cam_timeout );
1904 if( status != EOK ) {
1905 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: sdmmc_rw failed (%d)", __FUNCTION__, status );
1906 return( status );
1907 }
1908 else {
1909 for( ; sgc; sgc--, sgp++ ) {
1910 wptr = (char *)sgp->sg_address;
1911 if( ( ccb->cam_ch.cam_flags & CAM_DATA_PHYS ) ) {
1912 wptr = mmap( NULL, sgp->sg_count, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE | PROT_NOCACHE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_PHYS, -1, sgp->sg_address );
1913 if( wptr == MAP_FAILED ) {
1914 verification = CAM_FAILURE;
1915 break;
1916 }
1917 }
1918
1919 if( memcmp( wptr, rptr, sgp->sg_count ) ) {
1920 verification = CAM_FAILURE;
1921 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: write verification failed wrote", __FUNCTION__ );
1922 cam_dump( wptr, sgp->sg_count );
1923 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: write verification failed read", __FUNCTION__ );
1924 cam_dump( rptr, sgp->sg_count );
1925 }
1926
1927 if( ( ccb->cam_ch.cam_flags & CAM_DATA_PHYS ) ) {
1928 munmap( wptr, sgp->sg_count );
1929 }
1930
1931 rptr += sgp->sg_count;
1932 wptr += sgp->sg_count;
1933 }
1934 }
1935
1936 if( verification != CAM_SUCCESS ) {
1937 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: write verification failed", __FUNCTION__ );
1938 status = sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, EIO );
1939 }
1940
1941 return( status ? status : CAM_REQ_CMP );
1942}
1943#endif
1944
1945static void sdmmc_ccb_lba( uint8_t * const cdb, uint64_t *lba, uint32_t *nlba, uint8_t *opt )
1946{
1947 switch( cdb[0] ) {
1948 case SC_READ10:
1949 case SC_WRITE10:
1950 *lba = ENDIAN_BE32( UNALIGNED_RET32( &cdb[2] ) );
1951 *nlba = ENDIAN_BE16( UNALIGNED_RET16( &cdb[7] ) );
1952 break;
1953
1954 case SC_READ12:
1955 case SC_WRITE12:
1956 *lba = ENDIAN_BE32( UNALIGNED_RET32( &cdb[2] ) );
1957 *nlba = ENDIAN_BE32( UNALIGNED_RET32( &cdb[7] ) );
1958 break;
1959
1960 case SC_READ16:
1961 case SC_WRITE16:
1962 case SC_WR_SAME16:
1963 *lba = ENDIAN_BE64( UNALIGNED_RET64( &cdb[2] ) );
1964 *nlba = ENDIAN_BE32( UNALIGNED_RET32( &cdb[10] ) );
1965 break;
1966
1967 default:
1968 *lba = 0;
1969 *nlba = 0;
1970 break;
1971 }
1972
1973 if( opt ) {
1974 *opt = cdb[1];
1975 }
1976}
1977
1978int sdmmc_read_write( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_SCSIIO *ccb, int flgs )
1979{
1980 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
1981 SDMMC_PARTITION *part;
1982 uint64_t lba;
1983 uint32_t nblks;
1984 int status;
1985 int sgc;
1986 uint8_t opt;
1987 sdio_sge_t *sgp;
1988 sdio_sge_t sge;
1989#ifdef SDMMC_SIM_RETRY
1990 int retry;
1991#endif
1992
1993 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
1994 part = &ext->targets[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_id].partitions[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_lun];
1995
1996 status = sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, ccb );
1997 if( status != CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
1998 return( status );
1999 }
2000
2001 if( ( ext->dev_inf.flags & DEV_FLAG_CARD_LOCKED ) ) {
2002 return( sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, EACCES ) );
2003 }
2004
2005 sdmmc_ccb_lba( ccb->cam_cdb_io.cam_cdb_bytes, &lba, &nblks, &opt );
2006
2007 if( ( flgs & SCF_DIR_OUT ) ) {
2008 if( ( part->pflags & SDMMC_PFLAG_WP ) ) {
2009 return( sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, EROFS ) );
2010 }
2011
2012 if( ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_RELWR ) || ( ( opt & RW_OPT_FUA ) && ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_WR_REL ) ) ) {
2013 flgs |= SCF_SBC_RLW;
2014 }
2015 }
2016
2017 if( ( part->config & MMC_PART_MSK ) == MMC_PART_RPMB ) { // no read/write to RPMB
2018 return( CAM_PROVIDE_FAIL );
2019 }
2020
2021 status = sdio_set_partition( ext->device, part->config );
2022 if( status != EOK ) {
2023 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: sdio_set_partition failure %s", __FUNCTION__, strerror( status ) );
2024 sdmmc_reset( hba );
2025 return( sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, ETIMEDOUT ) );
2026 }
2027
2028 sdmmc_bkops( hba, CAM_FALSE ); // Check for urgent background operations
2029
2030 if( ( ccb->cam_ch.cam_flags & CAM_SCATTER_VALID ) ) {
2031 sgc = ccb->cam_sglist_cnt;
2032 sgp = (sdio_sge_t *)ccb->cam_data.cam_sg_ptr;
2033 }
2034 else {
2035 sgc = 1;
2036 sgp = &sge;
2037 sgp->sg_count = ccb->cam_dxfer_len;
2038 sgp->sg_address = ccb->cam_data.cam_data_ptr;
2039 }
2040
2041 if( ( ccb->cam_ch.cam_flags & CAM_DATA_PHYS ) ) {
2042 flgs |= SCF_DATA_PHYS;
2043 }
2044
2045 if( part->blk_shft ) {
2046 lba <<= part->blk_shft;
2047 }
2048
2049 lba += part->slba;
2050
2051 // Currently untested and is disabled via compile time option in mmc.[ch]. Validation requires older eMMC device.
2052 if( ( flgs & SCF_SBC_RLW ) && !( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_WR_REL_ENH ) ) {
2053 sdio_sge_t rw_sge;
2054 uint64_t sg_addr;
2055 uint32_t sg_count;
2056 uint32_t rel_wr_count;
2057 uint32_t count;
2058 uint32_t sgi;
2059
2060 rel_wr_count = ext->dev_inf.rel_wr_sec_c * 512;
2061
2062 for( sgi = 0; sgi < sgc; sgi++ ) {
2063 sg_addr = sgp[sgi].sg_address;
2064 sg_count = sgp[sgi].sg_count;
2065 while( sg_count ) {
2066 count = sg_count;
2067 // Legacy reliable write requirements:
2068 // The length of the write operation equals the supported reliable write size or 512B,
2069 // AND the start address of the reliable write operation is aligned to the length of the
2070 // operation (ie reliable write start address is alway multiple of its own length)
2071
2072 // check that lba is aligned with relaible write sector count
2073 if( !SDMMC_ADDR_ALIGNED( lba, ext->dev_inf.rel_wr_sec_c ) ) {
2074 count = 512;
2075 }
2076
2077 if( count > rel_wr_count ) {
2078 count = rel_wr_count;
2079 }
2080 else if( count <= rel_wr_count ) {
2081 count = 512;
2082 }
2083 else {
2084 // nothing
2085 }
2086
2087 rw_sge.sg_count = count;
2088 rw_sge.sg_address = sg_addr;
2089 status = sdmmc_rw( hba, part, flgs, lba, count, &rw_sge, 1, ccb->cam_req_map, ccb->cam_timeout );
2090 if( status != EOK ) {
2091 status = sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, status );
2092 return( status );
2093 }
2094 sg_count -= count;
2095 sg_addr += count;
2096 lba += ( count / 512 );
2097 }
2098 }
2099 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2100 }
2101
2102#ifdef SDMMC_SIM_RETRY
2103 retry = SDMMC_RW_RETRIES;
2104 do {
2105 status = sdmmc_rw( hba, part, flgs, lba, ccb->cam_dxfer_len, sgp, sgc, ccb->cam_req_map, ccb->cam_timeout );
2106 if( status == EOK ) {
2107 break;
2108 }
2109 } while( --retry && status == ETIMEDOUT );
2110
2111 if( status ) {
2112 if( status == ETIMEDOUT ) { // map timeout to eio
2113 status = EIO;
2114 }
2115 status = sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, status );
2116 }
2117#else
2118 status = sdmmc_rw( hba, part, flgs, lba, ccb->cam_dxfer_len, sgp, sgc, ccb->cam_req_map, ccb->cam_timeout );
2119 if( status != EOK ) {
2120 status = sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, status );
2121 }
2122#endif
2123 return( status ? status : CAM_REQ_CMP );
2124}

2126static int sdmmc_dsn_devctl( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_DEVCTL *ccb )
2127{
2128 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
2129 char *dsn;
2130 int ret = EOK;
2131 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
2132 dsn = ccb->cam_devctl_data;
2133 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EOK;
2134
2135 memset( dsn, 0, ccb->cam_devctl_size );
2136
2137 if( sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, (CCB_SCSIIO *)ccb ) != CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
2138 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EIO;
2139 }
2140 else {
2141 ret = snprintf( dsn, ccb->cam_devctl_size, "%08x", ext->dev_inf.psn );
2142 if ( ret < 0 ) {
2143 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: snprintf failed(%s)\n", __func__ , strerror(errno));
2144 }
2145 }
2146
2147 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2148}
2149
2150static int sdmmc_drvr_state_devctl( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_DEVCTL *ccb )
2151{
2152 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
2153 SDMMC_DRVR_STATE *ds;
2154
2155 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
2156 ds = ccb->cam_devctl_data;
2157
2158 if( sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, (CCB_SCSIIO *)ccb ) != CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
2159 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EIO;
2160 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2161 }
2162
2163 if( ds->state == SDMMC_DRVR_PAUSE ) {
2164 if( sdmmc_dev_dcfg( hba ) ) {
2165 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EIO;
2166 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2167 }
2168
2169 sdmmc_pm( hba, PM_IDLE );
2170
2171 // freeze the simq, so nothing will start until we receive the active
2172 ccb->cam_ch.cam_flags &= ~CAM_SIM_QFRZDIS;
2173 ccb->cam_ch.cam_flags |= CAM_SIM_QFREEZE;
2174
2175 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, sdmmc_ctrl.verbosity, 1, "%s: SDMMC_DRVR_PAUSE state", __FUNCTION__ );
2176 }
2177 else { // SDMMC_DRVR_RUN
2178 sdmmc_pm( hba, PM_ACTIVE );
2179 sdio_reset( ext->device );
2180 sdmmc_dev_cfg( hba );
2181 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, sdmmc_ctrl.verbosity, 1, "%s: SDMMC_DRVR_RUN state", __FUNCTION__ );
2182 }
2183
2184 ext->drvr_state = ds->state;
2185 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EOK;
2186
2187 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2188}

2190int sdmmc_wp_devctl( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_DEVCTL *ccb )
2191{
2192 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
2193 SDMMC_WRITE_PROTECT *wp;
2194 SDMMC_PARTITION *part;
2195 uint32_t op;
2196 uint32_t nlba;
2197 uint64_t slba;
2198 uint64_t pend;
2199 int status;
2200
2201 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
2202 wp = ccb->cam_devctl_data;
2203 part = &ext->targets[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_id].partitions[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_lun];
2204 nlba = max( 1, wp->nlba );
2205 slba = part->slba + wp->lba;
2206 pend = part->slba + part->nlba - 1;
2207 wp->mode &= SDMMC_WP_MODE_PWR_WP_EN; // limit mode to nothing permanent
2208 status = EOK;
2209
2210 switch( wp->action ) {
2211 case SDMMC_WP_ACTION_CLR:
2212 op = MMC_CLR_WRITE_PROT;
2213 break;
2214 case SDMMC_WP_ACTION_SET:
2215 op = MMC_SET_WRITE_PROT;
2216 break;
2217 case SDMMC_WP_ACTION_PROT:
2218 op = MMC_SEND_WRITE_PROT;
2219 break;
2220 case SDMMC_WP_ACTION_PROT_TYPE:
2221 op = MMC_SEND_WRITE_PROT_TYPE;
2222 break;
2223 default:
2224 op = 0;
2225 break;
2226 }
2227
2228 if( sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, (CCB_SCSIIO *)ccb ) != CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
2229 status = EIO;
2230 }
2231 else if( !op || ( slba > pend ) || ( ( slba + nlba - 1 ) > pend ) ) {
2232 status = EINVAL;
2233 }
2234 else if( ext->instance.ident.dtype != DEV_TYPE_MMC ) {
2235 status = ENOTSUP;
2236 }
2237 else {
2238 status = sdmmc_write_protect( hba, op, part->config, wp->mode, slba, nlba, &wp->prot );
2239 }
2240
2241 ccb->cam_devctl_status = status;
2242
2243 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2244}
2245
2246int sdmmc_erase_devctl( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_DEVCTL *ccb )
2247{
2248 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
2249 SDMMC_ERASE *erase;
2250 SDMMC_PARTITION *part;
2251 uint32_t nlba;
2252 uint64_t egs;
2253 uint64_t slba;
2254 uint64_t pend;
2255 int status;
2256
2257 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
2258 erase = ccb->cam_devctl_data;
2259 part = &ext->targets[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_id].partitions[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_lun];
2260 egs = ext->dev_inf.erase_size / 512;
2261 nlba = (uint32_t)erase->nlba;
2262 slba = part->slba + erase->lba;
2263 pend = part->slba + part->nlba - 1;
2264 status = EINVAL;
2265
2266 if( sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, (CCB_SCSIIO *)ccb ) != CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
2267 status = EIO;
2268 }
2269 else if( ( slba > pend ) || ( ( slba + nlba - 1 ) > pend ) ) {
2270 status = EINVAL; // verify request is within partition
2271 }
2272 else {
2273 switch( erase->action ) {
2274 case SDMMC_ERASE_ACTION_NORMAL:
2275 // verify for erase group alignment
2276 if( !( slba % egs ) && !( nlba % egs ) ) {
2277 status = sdio_erase( ext->device, part->config, MMC_ERASE_NORM, slba, nlba );
2278 if( status == EOK ) {
2279 part->ec += nlba;
2280 }
2281 }
2282 break;
2283
2284 case SDMMC_ERASE_ACTION_SECURE:
2285 // verify SECURE cap and erase group alignment
2286 if( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_SECURE ) && !( slba % egs ) && !( nlba % egs ) ) {
2287 status = sdio_erase( ext->device, part->config, MMC_ERASE_SECURE, slba, nlba );
2288 if( status == EOK ) {
2289 part->ec += nlba;
2290 }
2291 }
2292 break;
2293
2294 case SDMMC_ERASE_ACTION_TRIM:
2295 if( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_TRIM ) ) {
2296 status = sdio_erase( ext->device, part->config, MMC_ERASE_TRIM, slba, nlba );
2297 if( status == EOK ) {
2298 part->tc += nlba;
2299 }
2300 }
2301 break;
2302
2303 case SDMMC_ERASE_ACTION_SECURE_TRIM:
2304 if( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_SECURE_TRIM ) == DEV_CAP_SECURE_TRIM ) {
2305 status = sdio_erase( ext->device, part->config, MMC_ERASE_SECURE_TRIM, slba, nlba );
2306 if( status == EOK ) {
2307 part->tc += nlba;
2308 }
2309 }
2310 break;
2311
2312 case SDMMC_ERASE_ACTION_SECURE_PURGE:
2313 if( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_SECURE_TRIM ) == DEV_CAP_SECURE_TRIM ) {
2314 status = sdio_erase( ext->device, part->config, MMC_ERASE_SECURE_TRIM_PURGE, slba, nlba );
2315 }
2316 break;
2317
2318 case SDMMC_ERASE_ACTION_DISCARD:
2319 if( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_TRIM ) ) {
2320 status = sdio_erase( ext->device, part->config, MMC_ERASE_DISCARD, slba, nlba );
2321 if( status == EOK ) {
2322 part->dc += nlba;
2323 }
2324 }
2325 break;
2326
2327#if 0
2328 case SDMMC_ERASE_ACTION_SANITIZE:
2329 if( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_SANITIZE ) ) {
2330 if( ( status = sdio_mmc_switch( ext->device, MMC_SWITCH_CMDSET_DFLT, MMC_SWITCH_MODE_WRITE, ECSD_SANITIZE_START, ECSD_SANITIZE_INITIATE, SDIO_TIME_DEFAULT ) ) != EOK ) {
2331 // set flag to indicate we have started a sanitize
2332 ext->eflags |= SDMMC_EFLAG_DEV_BUSY;
2333 }
2334 }
2335 break;
2336#endif
2337
2338 default:
2339 status = EINVAL;
2340 break;
2341 }
2342 }
2343
2344 ccb->cam_devctl_status = status;
2345
2346 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2347}
2348
2349static int sdmmc_lock_unlock_devctl( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_DEVCTL *ccb )
2350{
2351 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
2352 SDMMC_LOCK_UNLOCK *lock;
2353 int status;
2354
2355 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
2356 lock = ccb->cam_devctl_data;
2357
2358 if( sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, (CCB_SCSIIO *)ccb ) != CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
2359 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EIO;
2360 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2361 }
2362 else if( ( lock->pwd_len > SDMMC_LU_PWD_SIZE ) ||
2363 ( ( lock->action != SDMMC_LU_ACTION_LOCK ) &&
2364 ( lock->action != SDMMC_LU_ACTION_SET ) &&
2365 ( lock->action != SDMMC_LU_ACTION_CLR ) &&
2366 ( lock->action != SDMMC_LU_ACTION_UNLOCK ) &&
2367 ( lock->action != SDMMC_LU_ACTION_ERASE ) ) ) {
2368 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EINVAL;
2369 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2370 }
2371 else {
2372 // nothing
2373 }
2374
2375 status = sdio_lock_unlock( ext->device, lock->action, lock->pwd, lock->pwd_len );
2376 if( status == EOK ) {
2377 sdio_dev_info( ext->device, &ext->dev_inf ); // update device info
2378 }
2379
2380 ccb->cam_devctl_status = status;
2381
2382 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2383}
2384
2385int sdmmc_card_register_devctl( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_DEVCTL *ccb )
2386{
2387 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
2388 SDMMC_CARD_REGISTER *cr;
2389 int len;
2390 uint8_t *dptr;
2391 uint8_t data[512];
2392 uint32_t data_sds[16] = {0};
2393
2394 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
2395 cr = ccb->cam_devctl_data;
2396 len = ccb->cam_devctl_size - sizeof( SDMMC_CARD_REGISTER );
2397 dptr = (uint8_t *)(cr + 1);
2398 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EOK;
2399
2400 if( sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, (CCB_SCSIIO *)ccb ) != CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
2401 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EIO;
2402 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2403 }
2404
2405 if( cr->action == SDMMC_CR_ACTION_READ ) {
2406 switch( cr->type ) {
2407 case SDMMC_REG_TYPE_CID:
2408 memcpy( dptr, sdio_get_raw_cid( ext->device ), min( len, MMC_CID_SIZE ) );
2409 break;
2410
2411 case SDMMC_REG_TYPE_CSD:
2412 memcpy( dptr, sdio_get_raw_csd( ext->device), min( len, MMC_CSD_SIZE ) );
2413 break;
2414
2415 case SDMMC_REG_TYPE_EXT_CSD:
2416 if( ext->instance.ident.dtype != DEV_TYPE_MMC ) {
2417 ccb->cam_devctl_status = ENOTSUP;
2418 }
2419 else {
2420 int status;
2421
2422 status = sdio_send_ext_csd( ext->device, data );
2423 if( status == EOK ) {
2424 memcpy( dptr, data, min( len, sizeof( data ) ) );
2425 }
2426 else if( status == ETIMEDOUT ) { // unresponsive device, attempt reset recovery
2427 sdmmc_reset( hba );
2428 ccb->cam_devctl_status = status;
2429 }
2430 else {
2431 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EIO;
2432 }
2433 }
2434 break;
2435
2436 case SDMMC_REG_TYPE_SCR:
2437 if( ext->instance.ident.dtype != DEV_TYPE_SD ) {
2438 ccb->cam_devctl_status = ENOTSUP;
2439 }
2440 else {
2441 memcpy( dptr, sdio_get_raw_scr( ext->device ), min( len, SD_SCR_SIZE ) );
2442 }
2443 break;
2444
2445 case SDMMC_REG_TYPE_SDS:
2446 if( ext->instance.ident.dtype != DEV_TYPE_SD ) {
2447 ccb->cam_devctl_status = ENOTSUP;
2448 }
2449 else {
2450 if( sdio_app_read_status( ext->device,data_sds) == EOK ) {
2451 memcpy( dptr, data_sds, min( len, sizeof(data_sds) ) );
2452 }
2453 else {
2454 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EIO;
2455 }
2456 }
2457 break;
2458
2459 default:
2460 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EINVAL;
2461 break;
2462 }
2463 cr->type = ext->instance.ident.dtype;
2464 }
2465 else if( cr->action == SDMMC_CR_ACTION_WRITE ) {
2466 if( ( cr->type == SDMMC_REG_TYPE_EXT_CSD ) && ( ext->instance.ident.dtype == DEV_TYPE_MMC ) ) {
2467 if( cr->address >= ECSD_REV ) {
2468 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EINVAL;
2469 }
2470 else if( sdio_mmc_switch( ext->device, MMC_SWITCH_CMDSET_DFLT, MMC_SWITCH_MODE_WRITE, cr->address, *dptr, SDIO_TIME_DEFAULT ) != EOK ) {
2471 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EIO;
2472 }
2473 else {
2474 // nothing
2475 }
2476 }
2477 else {
2478 ccb->cam_devctl_status = ENOTSUP;
2479 }
2480 }
2481 else {
2482 ccb->cam_devctl_status = ENOTSUP;
2483 }
2484
2485 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2486}
2487
2488static int sdmmc_verbosity_devctl( SIM_HBA *hba, CCB_DEVCTL *ccb )
2489{
2490 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
2491 CAM_VERBOSITY *ver;
2492
2493 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;

2498 if( ver->flags ) {

2506 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );

2509static int sdmmc_device_info_devctl( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_DEVCTL *ccb )
2510{
2511 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
2512 SDMMC_DEVICE_INFO *sdi;
2513 SDMMC_PARTITION *part;
2514 sdio_dev_info_t *di;
2515
2516 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
2517 sdi = ccb->cam_devctl_data;
2518 part = &ext->targets[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_id].partitions[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_lun];
2519 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EOK;
2520 di = &ext->dev_inf;
2521
2522 sdi->dtype = di->dtype;
2523 sdi->flags = di->flags;
2524 sdi->mid = di->mid;
2525 sdi->oid = di->oid;
2526 memcpy( sdi->pnm, di->pnm, sizeof( di->pnm ) );
2527 sdi->prv = di->prv;
2528 sdi->psn = di->psn;
2529 sdi->month = di->month;
2530 sdi->year = di->year;
2531 memcpy( sdi->vu, di->vu, sizeof( di->vu ) );
2532 sdi->rca = di->rca;
2533 sdi->spec_vers = di->spec_vers;
2534 sdi->spec_rev = di->spec_rev;
2535 sdi->security = di->security;
2536 sdi->caps = di->caps;
2537 sdi->dtr = di->dtr;
2538 sdi->timing = di->timing;
2539 sdi->bus_width = di->bus_width;
2540 sdi->sector_size = di->sector_size;
2541 sdi->super_page_size = di->super_page_size;
2542 sdi->native_sector_size = di->native_sector_size;
2543 sdi->wp_size = di->wp_size;
2544 sdi->erase_size = di->erase_size;
2545 sdi->optimal_trim_size = di->optimal_trim_size;
2546 sdi->optimal_read_size = di->optimal_read_size;
2547 sdi->optimal_write_size = di->optimal_write_size;
2548 sdi->speed_class = di->speed_class;
2549
2550#if defined( SIM_BS_DEVICE_INFO ) && defined( SIM_BS_DEVCTL )
2551 sim_bs_devctl( hba, ccb );
2552#endif
2553
2554 sdi->sectors = (uint32_t)part->nlba;
2555 sdi->start_sector = (uint32_t)part->slba;
2556
2557 if( part->elba >= RD_CAP_MAX_LBA32 ) {
2558 // return 0/0 if partition crosses a 32 bit max.
2559 sdi->sectors = 0;
2560 sdi->start_sector = 0;
2561 }
2562 else if( part->nlba >= RD_CAP_MAX_LBA32 ) {
2563 // limit sectors to 32 bit max
2564 sdi->sectors = RD_CAP_MAX_LBA32;
2565 }
2566 else {
2567 // nothing
2568 }
2569
2570 sdi->sectors64 = part->nlba;
2571 sdi->start_sector64 = part->slba;
2572
2573 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2574}

2576static int sdmmc_dsm( SIM_HBA * const hba, SDMMC_PARTITION *part, DATA_SET_MGNT *dsm, const uint32_t dtype )
2577{
2578 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
2579 DATA_SET_MGNT_RANGE *dsmr;
2580 uint64_t lba;
2581 uint32_t nlba;
2582 uint64_t pend;
2583 int status;
2584
2585 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
2586 dsmr = (DATA_SET_MGNT_RANGE *)(dsm + 1);
2587 pend = part->slba + part->nlba - 1;
2588 status = EOK;
2589
2590 // Note: dsm->nranges == 0 is used to test for support
2591 for( ; dsm->nranges; dsmr++, dsm->nranges-- ) {
2592 nlba = dsmr->nlba;
2593 lba = part->slba + dsmr->lba;
2594 if( ( lba > pend ) || ( ( lba + nlba - 1 ) > pend ) ) {
2595 status = EINVAL;
2596 break;
2597 }
2598
2599 status = sdio_erase( ext->device, part->config, dtype, lba, nlba );
2600 if( status ) {
2601 break;
2602 }
2603
2604 switch( dtype ) {
2605 case MMC_ERASE_TRIM:
2606 part->tc += nlba;
2607 break;
2608
2609 case MMC_ERASE_DISCARD:
2610 part->dc += nlba;
2611 break;
2612
2613 default:
2614 break;
2615 }
2616 }
2617
2618 return( status );
2619}
2620
2621static int sdmmc_dsm_devctl( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_DEVCTL *ccb )
2622{
2623 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
2624 SDMMC_PARTITION *part;
2625 DATA_SET_MGNT *dsm;
2626 int status;
2627
2628 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
2629 dsm = ccb->cam_devctl_data;
2630 part = &ext->targets[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_id].partitions[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_lun];
2631
2632 if( sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, (CCB_SCSIIO *)ccb ) != CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
2633 status = EIO;
2634 }
2635 else if( ccb->cam_devctl_size < ( sizeof( DATA_SET_MGNT ) + sizeof( DATA_SET_MGNT_RANGE ) * dsm->nranges ) ) {
2636 status = EINVAL;
2637 }
2638 else {
2639 switch( dsm->opt ) {
2640 case DSM_OPT_TRIM:
2641 if( !( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_TRIM ) ) {
2642 status = EINVAL;
2643 break;
2644 }
2645 status = sdmmc_dsm( hba, part, dsm, MMC_ERASE_TRIM );
2646 break;
2647
2648 case DSM_OPT_DISCARD:
2649 if( !( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_DISCARD ) ) {
2650 status = EINVAL;
2651 break;
2652 }
2653 status = sdmmc_dsm( hba, part, dsm, MMC_ERASE_DISCARD );
2654 break;
2655
2656 default:
2657 status = EINVAL;
2658 break;
2659 }
2660 }
2661
2662 ccb->cam_devctl_status = status;
2663
2664 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2665}

2667static int sdmmc_part_info_devctl( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_DEVCTL *ccb )
2668{
2669 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;

2672 int status;

2674 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;

2678
2679 if( sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, (CCB_SCSIIO *)ccb ) != CAM_REQ_CMP ) {

2683 status = EINVAL;
2684 }
2685 else {
2686 switch( pi->action ) {
2687 case SDMMC_PI_ACTION_GET:
2688 pi->ptype = part->config & MMC_PART_MSK;
2689 pi->pflags = part->pflags;

2691 pi->num_lba = part->nlba;

2693 pi->wc = part->wc;
2694 pi->dc = part->dc;
2695 pi->ec = part->ec;
2696 pi->tc = part->tc;
2697 break;
2698
2699 case SDMMC_PI_ACTION_CLR:
2700 pi->ptype = part->config & MMC_PART_MSK;
2701 pi->pflags = part->pflags;
2702 pi->start_lba = part->slba;
2703 pi->num_lba = part->nlba;
2704 pi->rc = part->rc;
2705 pi->wc = part->wc;
2706 pi->dc = part->dc;
2707 pi->ec = part->ec;
2708 pi->tc = part->tc;
2709 part->rc = 0;
2710 part->wc = 0;
2711 part->dc = 0;
2712 part->ec = 0;
2713 part->tc = 0;
2714 break;
2715
2716 default:
2717 status = EINVAL;
2718 break;
2719 }
2720 }
2721
2722 ccb->cam_devctl_status = status;
2723
2724 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
