2727static int sdmmc_pwr_mgnt_devctl( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_DEVCTL *ccb )
2728{
2729 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
2730 SDMMC_PWR_MGNT *pm;
2731 int status;
2732
2733 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
2734 pm = ccb->cam_devctl_data;
2735 status = EOK;
2736
2737 if( sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, (CCB_SCSIIO *)ccb ) != CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
2738 status = EIO;
2739 }
2740 else if( ccb->cam_devctl_size < ( sizeof( SDMMC_PWR_MGNT ) ) ) {
2741 status = EINVAL;
2742 }
2743 else {
2744 switch( pm->action ) {
2745 case SDMMC_PM_ACTION_GET:
2746 pm->idle_time = ext->pm_idle_time_ns / 1000000;
2747 pm->sleep_time = ext->pm_sleep_time_ns / 1000000;
2748 break;
2749
2750 case SDMMC_PM_ACTION_SET:
2751 // use chipset defaults as min limit
2752 if( ( pm->idle_time < ext->hc_inf.idle_time ) ||
2753 ( pm->sleep_time < ext->hc_inf.sleep_time ) ) {
2754 status = EINVAL;
2755 break;
2756 }
2757 ext->pm_idle_time_ns = SDMMC_TIMEOUT_MS_TO_NS( pm->idle_time );
2758 ext->pm_sleep_time_ns = SDMMC_TIMEOUT_MS_TO_NS( pm->sleep_time );
2759 break;
2760
2761 default:
2762 status = EINVAL;
2763 break;
2764 }
2765 }
2766
2767 ccb->cam_devctl_status = status;
2768
2769 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2770}
2771
2772static int sdmmc_rpmb_info( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_DEVCTL *ccb, RPMB_INFO *info, const int minsz )
2773{
2774 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
2775 SDMMC_PARTITION *part;
2776 uint8_t *ecsd;
2777 sdio_csd_t *csd;
2778
2779 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
2780
2781 if( ext->instance.ident.dtype != DEV_TYPE_MMC ) {
2782 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: the device doesn't support RPMB!", __FUNCTION__ );
2783 return( ENOTSUP );
2784 }
2785
2786 part = &ext->targets[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_id].partitions[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_lun];
2787 if( ( part->config & MMC_PART_MSK ) != MMC_PART_RPMB ) { // not RPMB partition
2788 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: not RPMB partition", __FUNCTION__ );
2789 return( ENOTSUP );
2790 }
2791
2792 if( ccb->cam_devctl_size < minsz ) {
2793 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: devctl buffer too small", __FUNCTION__ );
2794 return( EINVAL );
2795 }
2796
2797 ecsd = sdio_get_raw_ecsd( ext->device );
2798 csd = sdio_get_csd( ext->device );
2799
2800 memset( info, 0, sizeof( RPMB_INFO ) );
2801 info->maxio = ( ecsd[ECSD_WR_REL_PARAM] & ECSD_WRP_EN_RPMB_REL_WR ) ? 32 : 2;
2802 info->start_lba = part->slba;
2803 info->num_lba = part->nlba;
2804 info->parts = 1;
2805 info->dtype = RPMB_DTYPE_EMMC;
2806#if (_NTO_VERSION >= 800)
2807/* These elements are not present in SDP 7.1*/
2808 info->partitions[0].start_lba = part->slba;
2809 info->partitions[0].num_lba = part->nlba;
2810#endif
2811 info->flags = ( csd->write_protect & 0x01 ) ? RPMB_FLAG_WP : 0;
2812
2813 return( EOK );
2814}
2815
2816static int sdmmc_rpmb_devctl( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_DEVCTL *ccb )
2817{
2818 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
2819 SDMMC_PARTITION *part;
2820 uint32_t nf;
2821 int status;
2822 RPMB_CMDHDR *req;
2823 RPMB_INFO info;
2824 rpmb_frame_jedec_t *pf;
2825
2826 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
2827 req = ccb->cam_devctl_data;
2828
2829 status = sdmmc_rpmb_info( hba, ccb, &info, sizeof( RPMB_CMDHDR ) + req->nframes * RPMB_FRAME_SIZE );
2830 if( status != EOK ) {
2831 ccb->cam_devctl_status = status;
2832 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2833 }
2834
2835 if( req->flags == RPMB_FLG_RL_WRITE ) {
2836 if( info.flags & RPMB_FLAG_WP ) {
2837 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EACCES;
2838 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2839 }
2840 if( info.maxio < req->nframes ) {
2841 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: frame count[%d] exceed maximum write count[%d]", __FUNCTION__, req->nframes, info.maxio );
2842 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EINVAL;
2843 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2844 }
2845 }
2846
2847 status = sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, (CCB_SCSIIO *)ccb );
2848 if( status != CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
2849 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EIO;
2850 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2851 }
2852
2853 sdmmc_bkops( hba, CAM_FALSE ); // Check for urgent background operations
2854
2855 // Switch to RPMB partition
2856 part = &ext->targets[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_id].partitions[ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_lun];
2857 status = sdio_set_partition( ext->device, part->config );
2858 if( status != EOK ) {
2859 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: sdio_set_partition failure %s", __FUNCTION__, strerror( status ) );
2860 sdmmc_reset( hba );
2861 ccb->cam_devctl_status = status;
2862 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2863 }
2864
2865 pf = (rpmb_frame_jedec_t *)( req + 1 );
2866 // Write authentication key or data, use reliable write
2867 if( req->flags != RPMB_FLG_READ ) {
2868 status = sdio_mmc_rpmb_rw( ext->device, pf, req->nframes, SCF_DIR_OUT | SCF_SBC_RLW );
2869 if( status != EOK ) {
2870 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s, %d: sdio_mmc_rpmb_rw failure: %s", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, strerror( status ) );
2871 sdmmc_reset( hba );
2872 ccb->cam_devctl_status = status;
2873 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2874 }
2875
2876 // Need to send read result request
2877 memset( pf, 0, RPMB_FRAME_SIZE );
2878 pf->req_resp = ENDIAN_BE16( RPMB_READ_RESULT );
2879 }
2880
2881 // Send read request (data or write result)
2882 pf->block_count = 0; // block count has to be zero by spec
2883 status = sdio_mmc_rpmb_rw( ext->device, pf, 1, SCF_DIR_OUT );
2884 if( status != EOK ) {
2885 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s, %d: sdio_mmc_rpmb_rw failure: %s", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, strerror( status ) );
2886 sdmmc_reset( hba );
2887 ccb->cam_devctl_status = status;
2888 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2889 }
2890
2891 // read data, write counter or write result
2892 nf = ( req->flags == RPMB_FLG_READ ) ? req->nframes : 1;
2893 status = sdio_mmc_rpmb_rw( ext->device, pf, nf, SCF_DIR_IN );
2894 if( status != EOK ) {
2895 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s, %d: sdio_mmc_rpmb_rw failure: %s", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, strerror( status ) );
2896 sdmmc_reset( hba );
2897 ccb->cam_devctl_status = status;
2898 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2899 }
2900
2901 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EOK;
2902
2903 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2904}
2905
2906static int sdmmc_rpmb_info_devctl( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_DEVCTL *ccb )
2907{
2908 ccb->cam_devctl_status = sdmmc_rpmb_info( hba, ccb,
2909 (RPMB_INFO *)ccb->cam_devctl_data, sizeof( RPMB_INFO ) );
2910
2911 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2912}
2913
2914static int sdmmc_gencmd_devctl( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_DEVCTL *ccb )
2915{
2916 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
2917 SDMMC_GEN_CMD *req;
2918 int status;
2919 void *buf;
2920 uint32_t flags;
2921 uint32_t arg;
2922
2923 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
2924 req = ccb->cam_devctl_data;
2925
2926 status = sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, (CCB_SCSIIO *)ccb );
2927 if( status != CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
2928 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EIO;
2929 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2930 }
2931
2932 sdmmc_bkops( hba, CAM_FALSE ); // Check for urgent background operations
2933
2934 for( ; ; ) {
2935 buf = (void *)( req + 1 );
2936 flags = SCF_CTYPE_ADTC | SCF_RSP_R1;
2937 arg = req->arg;
2938
2939 if( ( req->flags & SDMMC_GENCMD_DIR ) == SDMMC_GENCMD_READ ) {
2940 flags |= SCF_DIR_IN;
2941 }
2942 else {
2943 flags |= SCF_DIR_OUT;
2944 }
2945
2946 status = sdio_mmc_gen_man( ext->device, MMC_GEN_CMD, buf, req->blklen, 1, arg, flags);
2947 if( status != EOK ) {
2948 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s, %d: sdio_mmc_gencmd failure: %s", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, strerror( status ) );
2949 sdmmc_reset( hba );
2950 ccb->cam_devctl_status = status;
2951 break;
2952 }
2953
2954 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EOK;
2955
2956 if( ( req->flags & SDMMC_GENCMD_NEXT ) == 0 ) {
2957 break;
2958 }
2959
2960 req = (SDMMC_GEN_CMD *)( (uintptr_t)buf + req->blklen );
2961 }
2962
2963 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2964}
2965
2966static int sdmmc_mancmd_devctl( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_DEVCTL *ccb )
2967{
2968 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
2969 SDMMC_MAN_CMD *req;
2970 int status;
2971 uint8_t op;
2972 void *buf;
2973 uint32_t flags;
2974 uint32_t arg;
2975
2976 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
2977 req = ccb->cam_devctl_data;
2978
2979 status = sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, (CCB_SCSIIO *)ccb );
2980 if( status != CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
2981 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EIO;
2982 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
2983 }
2984
2985 sdmmc_bkops( hba, CAM_FALSE ); // Check for urgent background operations
2986
2987 for( ; ; ) {
2988 op = req->flags & SDMMC_MANCMD_CMD;
2989 if( ( op < MMC_MAN_CMD1 ) || ( op > MMC_MAN_CMD4 ) ) {
2990 ccb->cam_devctl_status = ENOTSUP;
2991 break;
2992 }
2993
2994 buf = ( req->flags & SDMMC_MANCMD_ADTC ) ? (void *)( req + 1 ) : NULL;
2995 flags = 0;
2996 arg = req->arg;
2997
2998 if( ( req->flags & SDMMC_MANCMD_TYPE ) == SDMMC_MANCMD_ADTC ) {
2999 flags |= SCF_CTYPE_ADTC;
3000 }
3001 if( ( req->flags & SDMMC_MANCMD_DIR ) == SDMMC_MANCMD_READ ) {
3002 flags |= SCF_DIR_IN;
3003 }
3004 if( ( req->flags & SDMMC_MANCMD_RSP ) == SDMMC_MANCMD_R1 ) {
3005 flags |= SCF_RSP_R1;
3006 }
3007 else {
3008 flags |= SCF_RSP_R1B;
3009 }
3010
3011 status = sdio_mmc_gen_man( ext->device, op, buf, req->blklen, 1, arg, flags);
3012 if( status != EOK ) {
3013 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s, %d: sdio_mmc_mancmd failure: %s", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, strerror( status ) );
3014 sdmmc_reset( hba );
3015 ccb->cam_devctl_status = status;
3016 break;
3017 }
3018
3019 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EOK;
3020
3021 if( ( req->flags & SDMMC_MANCMD_NEXT ) == 0 ) {
3022 break;
3023 }
3024
3025 req = (SDMMC_MAN_CMD *)( (uintptr_t)((void *)( req + 1 )) + req->blklen );
3026 }
3027
3028 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
3029}
3030
3031static int sdmmc_devctl_perm( CCB_DEVCTL *ccb )
3032{
3033 int ret;
3034
3035 ret = CAM_REQ_INPROG;
3036
3037 switch( ccb->cam_devctl_dcmd ) {
3038 case DCMD_SDMMC_DEVICE_INFO:
3039 case DCMD_SDMMC_ERASE:
3040 case DCMD_SDMMC_WRITE_PROTECT:
3041 case DCMD_SDMMC_CARD_REGISTER:
3042 case DCMD_SDMMC_ASSD_STATUS:
3043 case DCMD_SDMMC_ASSD_PROPERTIES:
3044 case DCMD_SDMMC_ASSD_CONTROL:
3045 case DCMD_SDMMC_ASSD_APDU:
3046 case DCMD_SDMMC_LOCK_UNLOCK:
3047 case DCMD_SDMMC_PART_INFO:
3048 case DCMD_SDMMC_PWR_MGNT:
3049 case DCMD_CAM_VERBOSITY:
3050 case DCMD_CAM_DEV_SERIAL_NUMBER:
3051 case DCMD_CAM_DATA_SET_MGNT:
3052 case DCMD_RPMB_INFO:
3053 case DCMD_RPMB_CMD:
3054 case DCMD_SDMMC_GEN_CMD:
3055 case DCMD_SDMMC_MAN_CMD:
3056 case DCMD_SDMMC_DRVR_STATE:
3057 // fail requests without RD or WR
3058 if( !( ccb->cam_devctl_ioflag & ( _IO_FLAG_RD | _IO_FLAG_WR ) ) ) {
3059 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: dcmd 0x%x, EACCES", __FUNCTION__, ccb->cam_devctl_dcmd );
3060 ccb->cam_devctl_status = EACCES;
3061 ret = CAM_REQ_CMP;
3062 }
3063 break;
3064
3065 default:
3066 break;
3067 }
3068
3069 return( ret );
3070}
3071
3072static int sdmmc_devctl( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_DEVCTL * const ccb )
3073{
3074 int status;
3075
3076 status = CAM_REQ_CMP;
3077
3078 if( sdmmc_devctl_perm( ccb ) ) {
3079 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
3080 }
3081
3082 switch( ccb->cam_devctl_dcmd ) {
3083 case DCMD_SDMMC_DEVICE_INFO:
3084 status = sdmmc_device_info_devctl( hba, ccb );
3085 break;
3086
3087 case DCMD_SDMMC_ERASE:
3088 status = sdmmc_erase_devctl( hba, ccb );
3089 break;
3090
3091 case DCMD_SDMMC_WRITE_PROTECT:
3092 status = sdmmc_wp_devctl( hba, ccb );
3093 break;
3094
3095 case DCMD_SDMMC_CARD_REGISTER:
3096 status = sdmmc_card_register_devctl( hba, ccb );
3097 break;
3098
3099 case DCMD_SDMMC_ASSD_STATUS:
3100 status = sdmmc_assd_status_devctl( hba, ccb );
3101 break;
3102
3103 case DCMD_SDMMC_ASSD_PROPERTIES:
3104 status = sdmmc_assd_properties_devctl( hba, ccb );
3105 break;
3106
3107 case DCMD_SDMMC_ASSD_CONTROL:
3108 status = sdmmc_assd_control_devctl( hba, ccb );
3109 break;
3110
3111 case DCMD_SDMMC_ASSD_APDU:
3112 status = sdmmc_assd_apdu_devctl( hba, ccb );
3113 break;
3114
3115 case DCMD_SDMMC_LOCK_UNLOCK:
3116 status = sdmmc_lock_unlock_devctl( hba, ccb );
3117 break;
3118
3119 case DCMD_SDMMC_PART_INFO:
3120 status = sdmmc_part_info_devctl( hba, ccb );
3121 break;
3122
3123 case DCMD_SDMMC_PWR_MGNT:
3124 status = sdmmc_pwr_mgnt_devctl( hba, ccb );
3125 break;
3126
3127 case DCMD_CAM_VERBOSITY:
3128 status = sdmmc_verbosity_devctl( hba, ccb );
3129 break;
3130
3131 case DCMD_CAM_DEV_SERIAL_NUMBER:
3132 status = sdmmc_dsn_devctl( hba, ccb );
3133 break;
3134
3135 case DCMD_CAM_DATA_SET_MGNT:
3136 status = sdmmc_dsm_devctl( hba, ccb );
3137 break;
3138
3139 case DCMD_RPMB_INFO:
3140 status = sdmmc_rpmb_info_devctl( hba, ccb );
3141 break;
3142
3143 case DCMD_RPMB_CMD:
3144 status = sdmmc_rpmb_devctl( hba, ccb );
3145 break;
3146
3147 case DCMD_SDMMC_GEN_CMD:
3148 status = sdmmc_gencmd_devctl( hba, ccb );
3149 break;
3150
3151 case DCMD_SDMMC_MAN_CMD:
3152 status = sdmmc_mancmd_devctl( hba, ccb );
3153 break;
3154
3155 case DCMD_SDMMC_DRVR_STATE:
3156 status = sdmmc_drvr_state_devctl( hba, ccb );
3157 break;
3158
3159 default:
3160#ifdef SIM_BS_DEVCTL
3161// Note: bs module must validate ioflags
3162 status = sim_bs_devctl( hba, ccb );
3163#endif
3164 break;
3165 }
3166
3167 return( status );
3168}

3170static int sdmmc_service_action( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_SCSIIO * const ccb )
3171{
3172 int action;
3173 int status;
3174
3175 action = ccb->cam_cdb_io.cam_cdb_bytes[1] & SAI_SERVICE_ACTION_MSK;
3176
3177#ifdef SDMMC_SIM_DEBUG
3178 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s (ptl %d:%d:%"PRIu64") action %x",
3179 __FUNCTION__, (int)hba->pathid, ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_id, ccb->cam_ch.cam_target_lun, action );
3180#endif
3181
3182 switch( action ) {
3183 case SAI_READ_CAPACITY_16:
3184 status = sdmmc_capacity( hba, ccb, action );
3185 break;
3186
3187 default:
3188 status = sdmmc_sense( ccb, SK_ILLEGAL, ASC_INVALID_FIELD, 0 );
3189 break;
3190 }
3191
3192 return( status );
3193}
3194
3195// interpret SCSI commands
3196static int sdmmc_scsi_io( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_SCSIIO * const ccb )
3197{
3198 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
3199 int cmd;
3200 int status;
3201
3202 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
3203 cmd = ccb->cam_cdb_io.cam_cdb_bytes[0];
3204
3205 if( hba->verbosity > 3 ) {
3206 xpt_display_ccb( ccb, hba->verbosity );
3207 }
3208
3209 if( ccb->cam_dxfer_len && ( ccb->cam_ch.cam_flags & CAM_DATA_PHYS ) &&
3210 !( ext->hc_inf.caps & HC_CAP_DMA ) ) {
3211 return( CAM_PROVIDE_FAIL );
3212 }
3213
3214 switch( cmd ) {
3215 case SC_UNIT_RDY:
3216 status = sdmmc_unit_ready( hba, ccb );
3217 break;
3218
3219 case SC_INQUIRY:
3220 status = sdmmc_inquiry( hba, ccb );
3221 break;
3222
3223 case SC_SPINDLE:
3224 status = sdmmc_spindle( hba, ccb );
3225 break;
3226
3227 case SC_RD_CAP:
3228 status = sdmmc_capacity( hba, ccb, 0 );
3229 break;
3230
3231 case SC_READ10:
3232 status = sdmmc_read_write( hba, ccb, SCF_DIR_IN );
3233 break;
3234
3235 case SC_WRITE10:
3236 if( ( ext->dev_inf.caps & DEV_CAP_CACHE ) && ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_CACHE ) ) {
3237 // Note: We set the dirty flag prior to making the write request. It is possible
3238 // for the request to fail, but we don't know a what point. The write could have
3239 // completed, but we timeout on getting the status. The write routine may even
3240 // reset the device, clearing the volatile cache.
3241 ext->eflags |= SDMMC_EFLAG_VCACHE_DIRTY;
3242 }
3243 status = sdmmc_read_write( hba, ccb, SCF_DIR_OUT );
3244
3245#ifdef SDMMC_WRITE_VERIFY
3246 if( status == CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
3247 status = sdmmc_write_verify( hba, ccb );
3248 }
3249#endif
3250 break;
3251
3252 case SC_SYNC:
3253 status = sdmmc_sync( hba, ccb );
3254 break;
3255
3256 case SC_MSELECT10:
3257 status = sdmmc_mode_select( hba, ccb );
3258 break;
3259
3260 case SC_MSENSE10:
3261 status = sdmmc_mode_sense( hba, ccb );
3262 break;
3263
3264 case SC_ERASE12:
3265 status = sdmmc_erase12( hba, ccb );
3266 break;
3267
3268 case SC_WR_BUF:
3269 status = sdmmc_ffu( hba, ccb );
3270 break;
3271
3272#ifdef SDMMC_TRIM_SUP
3273 case SC_WR_SAME16:
3274 status = sdmmc_write_same( hba, ccb );
3275 break;
3276#endif
3277
3278 case SC_SERVICE_ACTION_IN16:
3279 status = sdmmc_service_action( hba, ccb );
3280 break;
3281
3282 default:
3283#if defined SIM_BS_PASS_THROUGH
3284 status = sim_bs_pass_through( hba, ccb );
3285 if( status != CAM_REQ_INVALID ) {
3286 break;
3287 }
3288#endif
3289 return( sdmmc_error( hba, ccb, EINVAL ) );
3290 }
3291
3292 return( status );
3293}
3294
3295static void sdmmc_start_ccb( SIM_HBA * const hba )
3296{
3297 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
3298 CCB_SCSIIO *ccb;
3299 int scnt;
3300 int status;
3301
3302 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
3303 status = CAM_REQ_CMP_ERR;
3304 scnt = 0;
3305
3306 do {
3307 ccb = simq_ccb_dequeue( hba->simq );
3308 if( ccb == NULL ) {
3309#ifdef SDMMC_AGGRESSIVE_PM
3310 // In aggressive pm mode we direct call the sdio layer,
3311 // so we don't have the overhead of enabling/disabling
3312 // the local PM timer.
3313 sdio_pwrmgnt( ext->device, PM_IDLE );
3314#endif
3315 break;
3316 }
3317
3318 ext->nexus = ccb;
3319
3320 sdmmc_pm( hba, PM_ACTIVE );
3321
3322 switch( ccb->cam_ch.cam_func_code ) {
3323 case XPT_SCSI_IO:
3324 status = sdmmc_scsi_io( hba, ccb );
3325 break;
3326
3327 case XPT_DEVCTL:
3328 status = sdmmc_devctl( hba, (CCB_DEVCTL *)ccb );
3329 break;
3330
3331 default:
3332 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1,
3333 "%s: unsupported func code %d", __FUNCTION__, ccb->cam_ch.cam_func_code );
3334 status = CAM_REQ_CMP_ERR;
3335 break;
3336 }
3337
3338 if( status != CAM_REQ_INPROG ) {
3339 ccb->cam_ch.cam_status = (uint8_t)status;
3340 sdmmc_post_ccb( hba, ccb );
3341 if( sdio_retune( ext->device ) != EOK ) { // in case retune is needed
3342 sdmmc_reset( hba );
3343 }
3344 }
3345
3346 // loop starting new requests until scnt reaches max
3347 // scnt max is needed to allow for handling of pulse
3348 // events ie power management, bkops
3349 } while( ( ext->nexus == NULL ) && ( ++scnt < ext->start_ccb_max ) );
3350
3351 if( scnt == ext->start_ccb_max ) {
3352 // trigger a pulse to start next request
3353 if( MsgSendPulse( hba->coid, hba->priority, SIM_ENQUEUE, 0 ) == -1 ) {
3354 }
3355 }
3356}
3357
3358static int sdmmc_timer( SIM_HBA * const hba )
3359{
3360 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
3361 int status;
3362 int pm_state;
3363 uint64_t timestamp;
3364 struct timespec ts;
3365
3366 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
3367 status = EOK;
3368 pm_state = ext->pm_state;
3369
3370 if( ext->nexus || ( pm_state == PM_SLEEP ) || ( pm_state == PM_SUSPEND ) || ( ext->drvr_state == SDMMC_DRVR_PAUSE ) ) {
3371 return( status );
3372 }
3373
3374 clock_gettime( CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts );
3375
3376 timestamp = timespec2nsec( &ts );
3377
3378 if( pm_state == PM_ACTIVE ) {
3379 if( timestamp >= ( ext->pm_timestamp + ext->pm_idle_time_ns ) ) {
3380 sdmmc_pm( hba, PM_IDLE );
3381 }
3382 }
3383 else if( ( pm_state == PM_IDLE ) && ( ext->hc_inf.caps & HC_CAP_SLEEP ) ) {
3384 if( timestamp >= ( ext->pm_timestamp + ext->pm_sleep_time_ns ) ) {
3385 if( sdmmc_cache_flush( hba ) == EOK ) {
3386 sdmmc_pm( hba, PM_SLEEP );
3387 }
3388 }
3389 }
3390 else {
3391 // nothing
3392 }
3393
3394 return( status );
3395}
3396
3397static int sdmmc_simq_state( SIM_HBA * const hba, const int state )
3398{
3399 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
3400 SDMMC_TARGET *targ;
3401 CCB_RELSIM ccb;
3402 target_id_t tgt;
3403 target_id_t lun;
3404
3405 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
3406
3407 memset( &ccb, 0, sizeof( ccb ) );
3408
3409 // set targets
3410 for( tgt = 0; tgt <= ext->ntargs; tgt++ ) {
3411 targ = &ext->targets[tgt];
3412 for( lun = 0; lun <= targ->nluns; lun++ ) {
3413 ccb.cam_ch.cam_target_id = tgt;
3414 ccb.cam_ch.cam_target_lun = lun;
3415 if( state ) {
3416 simq_rel_simq( hba->simq, &ccb );
3417 }
3418 else {
3419 simq_frz_simq( hba->simq, &ccb );
3420 }
3421 }
3422 }
3423
3424 if( state ) {
3425 // send pulse to start queued requests
3426 if( MsgSendPulse( hba->coid, hba->priority, SIM_ENQUEUE, 0 ) == -1 ) {
3427 }
3428 }
3429
3430 return( EOK );
3431}
3432
3433static void *sdmmc_ac_os_pwr_thread( void * const hdl )
3434{
3435 SIM_HBA *hba;
3436
3437 hba = hdl;
3438
3439 // push up event so cam/peripheral drivers can have io-blk/filesystems flush/sync
3440 xpt_async( AC_OS_PWR_SIGNAL, hba->pathid, -1, -1, NULL, 0 );
3441 pthread_sleepon_lock( );
3442 hba->state = CAM_TRUE;
3443 pthread_sleepon_unlock( );
3444 return( NULL );
3445}
3446
3447static int sdmmc_os_pwr_signal( SIM_HBA *hba )
3448{
3449 int state;
3450 pthread_t tid;
3451 int status;
3452
3453 hba->state = CAM_FALSE;
3454 state = CAM_FALSE;
3455
3456// cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s: start", __FUNCTION__ );
3457
3458 // spin a thread to send xpt_async (blocking call), then loop processing requests until sync/flush has completed
3459 status = cam_create_thread( &tid, NULL, sdmmc_ac_os_pwr_thread, hba, hba->priority, NULL, "sdmmc_ac_os_pwr_thread" );
3460 if( status == EOK ) {
3461 while( state == CAM_FALSE ) {
3462 sdmmc_start_ccb( hba );
3463 pthread_sleepon_lock( );
3464 state = hba->state;
3465 pthread_sleepon_unlock( );
3466 if( state == CAM_FALSE ) {
3467 delay( 1 );
3468 }
3469 }
3470 pthread_join( tid, NULL );
3471// cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s: complete", __FUNCTION__ );
3472 }
3473 else {
3474 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: sdmmc_ac_os_pwr_thread creation failure", __FUNCTION__ );
3475 }
3476 return( status );
3477}
3478
3479int sdmmc_suspend( SIM_HBA * const hba )
3480{
3481 sdmmc_pm( hba, PM_ACTIVE );
3482 sdmmc_os_pwr_signal( hba );
3483 sdmmc_dev_dcfg( hba );
3484 sdmmc_simq_state( hba, CAM_FALSE ); // freeze simqs
3485 sdmmc_pm( hba, PM_SUSPEND );
3486 return( EOK );
3487}
3488
3489int sdmmc_resume( SIM_HBA * const hba )
3490{
3491 sdmmc_pm( hba, PM_ACTIVE );
3492 sdmmc_dev_cfg( hba );
3493 sdmmc_simq_state( hba, CAM_TRUE ); // unfreeze simqs
3494 return( EOK );
3495}
3496
3497#ifdef SDMMC_POWMAN_SUP
3498static int sdmmc_powman_allowed_mode_list_update( SIM_HBA *hba )
3499{
3500 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
3501 struct sigevent event;
3502 unsigned req_num;
3503 void **allowed_list[sizeof( sdmmc_pm_states_list ) / sizeof( sdmmc_pm_states_list[0] )];
3504 void **mode;
3505 int status;
3506
3507 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
3508
3509 status = powman_get_allowed_modes( ext->powman_hdl, &req_num, allowed_list );
3510 if( status != EOK ) {
3511 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s powman_get_allowed_modes failed: %s", __FUNCTION__, strerror( status ) );
3512 return( status );
3513 }
3514
3515 mode = allowed_list[0];
3516
3517 if( mode != NULL ) {
3518 if( mode == (void **)&sdmmc_pm_state_on ) { // resume
3519 if( ext->pm_state == PM_SUSPEND ) {
3520 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s: resume %s", __FUNCTION__, ext->powman_name ? ext->powman_name : __progname );
3521 sdmmc_resume( hba );
3522 }
3523 else {
3524// cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s Already active", __FUNCTION__ );
3525 }
3526 }
3527 else if( mode == (void **)&sdmmc_pm_state_suspend ) { // suspend
3528 if( ext->pm_state != PM_SUSPEND ) {
3529 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s: suspend %s", __FUNCTION__, ext->powman_name ? ext->powman_name : __progname );
3530 sdmmc_suspend( hba );
3531 }
3532 else {
3533// cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s Already suspended", __FUNCTION__ );
3534 }
3535 }
3536 else {
3537 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: Unsupported mode", __FUNCTION__ );
3538 return( EINVAL );
3539 }
3540 }
3541 else {
3542 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: No valid allowed modes", __FUNCTION__ );
3543 return( EINVAL );
3544 }
3545
3546 status = powman_set_current_mode( ext->powman_hdl, req_num, mode );
3547 if( status != EOK ) {
3548 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: powman_mode_set failed, error (%d) %s", __FUNCTION__, status, strerror( status ) );
3549 return( status );
3550 }
3551
3552 // re-register to get the next pulse. Note: + 1 to give powman priority
3553 SIGEV_PULSE_INIT( &event, hba->coid, hba->priority + 1, SDMMC_POWMAN_UPDATE, NULL );
3554 status = powman_request_allowed_modes_event( ext->powman_hdl, &event );
3555 if( status != EOK ) {
3556 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: Failed re-register for power events, error (%d) %s", __FUNCTION__, status, strerror( status ) );
3557 return( status );
3558 }
3559
3560 return( EOK );
3561}
3562
3563void sdmmc_powman_disconnect( SIM_HBA *hba )
3564{
3565 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
3566
3567 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
3568
3569 if( ext->powman_hdl != NULL ) {
3570 powman_disconnect( ext->powman_hdl );
3571 powman_destroy( ext->powman_hdl );
3572 ext->powman_hdl = NULL;
3573 }
3574}
3575
3576static int sdmmc_powman_connect( SIM_HBA *hba )
3577{
3578 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
3579 int status;
3580 struct sigevent event;
3581
3582 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
3583 status = EOK;
3584
3585 if( ext->powman_hdl ) {
3586 // setup powman reconnect notification pulse event
3587 SIGEV_PULSE_INIT( &event, hba->coid, hba->priority, SDMMC_POWMAN_RECONNECT, NULL );
3588 status = powman_connect_event( ext->powman_hdl, &event );
3589 if( status == EOK ) {
3590 status = powman_connect( ext->powman_hdl );
3591 if( status != EOK ) {
3592 // not fatal, will be notified via reconnect pulse
3593 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_INFO, 1, 1, "%s powman_connect() failed, error (%d) %s, will retry when powerman comes online", __FUNCTION__, status, strerror( status ) );
3594 }
3595
3596 // setup powman update notification pulse event
3597 SIGEV_PULSE_INIT( &event, hba->coid, hba->priority + 1, SDMMC_POWMAN_UPDATE, NULL );
3598 status = powman_request_allowed_modes_event( ext->powman_hdl, &event );
3599 if( status == EOK ) {
3600 return( EOK );
3601 }
3602 else {
3603 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s powman_request_allowed_modes_event() failed, error (%d) %s", __FUNCTION__, status, strerror( status ) );
3604 }
3605 }
3606 else {
3607 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s powman_connect_event() failed, error (%d) %s", __FUNCTION__, status, strerror( status ) );
3608 }
3609 }
3610
3611 return( status );
3612}
3613
3614static int sdmmc_powman_create( SIM_HBA *hba )
3615{
3616 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
3617 int status;
3618
3619 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
3620
3621 // Create powman object with our name, set initial powman state to on/active, initial mode 0 (on)
3622 ext->powman_hdl = powman_create( ext->powman_name ? ext->powman_name : __progname, "sdmmc", "storage", (void ***)sdmmc_pm_states_list, 1, (void *)sdmmc_pm_states_list[0] );
3623 if( ext->powman_hdl != NULL ) {
3624 status = sdmmc_powman_connect( hba );
3625 if( status == EOK ) {
3626 return( status );
3627 }
3628 }
3629 else {
3630 status = errno;
3631 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s powman_create failed, error (%d) %s", __FUNCTION__, status, strerror( status ) );
3632 }
3633
3634 sdmmc_powman_disconnect( hba );
3635 return( status );
3636}
3637#endif
3638
3639void *sdmmc_driver_thread( void * const hdl )
3640{
3641 SIM_HBA *hba;
3642 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
3643 struct _pulse pulse;
3644 struct sigevent event;
3645 int rid;
3646 int status;
3647
3648 hba = hdl;
3649 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
3650 status = CAM_FALSE;
3651
3652 ext->drvr_state = SDMMC_DRVR_RUN;
3653
3654 hba->chid = ChannelCreate( _NTO_CHF_DISCONNECT | _NTO_CHF_UNBLOCK );
3655 if( hba->chid == -1 ) {
3656 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s ChannelCreate failure %s", __FUNCTION__, strerror( errno ) );
3657 status = CAM_TRUE;
3658 }
3659
3660 if( !status ) {
3661 hba->coid = ConnectAttach( 0, 0, hba->chid, _NTO_SIDE_CHANNEL, 0 );
3662 if( hba->coid == -1 ) {
3663 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s ConnectAttach failure %s", __FUNCTION__, strerror( errno ) );
3664 status = CAM_TRUE;
3665 }
3666 }
3667
3668 SIGEV_PULSE_INIT( &event, hba->coid, (short)hba->priority, SDMMC_PM_TIMER, NULL );
3669 if( !status && ( timer_create( CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &event, &ext->pm_timerid ) == -1 ) ) {
3670 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: timer_create", __FUNCTION__ );
3671 status = CAM_TRUE;
3672 }
3673
3674#ifdef SDMMC_POWMAN_SUP
3675 if( ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_POWMAN ) && sdmmc_powman_create( hba ) ) {
3676 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: sdmmc_powman_create", __FUNCTION__ );
3677 status = CAM_TRUE;
3678 }
3679#endif
3680
3681 // initialize SIM queue routines
3682 if( !status ) {
3683 hba->simq = simq_init( hba->coid, hba, MAX_NARROW_TARGET,
3684 MAX_LUN, 2, 1, 2, ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_BKOPS ) ? 1 : 0 );
3685 if( hba->simq == NULL ) {
3686 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: simq_init failure", __FUNCTION__ );
3687 status = CAM_TRUE;
3688 }
3689 }
3690
3691 if( status ) {
3692 cam_set_thread_state( &hba->state, CAM_TSTATE_INIT_FAILURE );
3693 return( NULL );
3694 }
3695
3696 cam_set_thread_state( &hba->state, CAM_TSTATE_INITIALIZED );
3697
3698 while( 1 ) {
3699 rid = MsgReceivePulse( hba->chid, &pulse, sizeof( pulse ), NULL );
3700 if( rid == -1 ) {
3701 break;
3702 }
3703
3704 switch( pulse.code ) {
3705 case SIM_ENQUEUE:
3706 sdmmc_start_ccb( hba );
3707 break;
3708
3709 case SIM_TIMER:
3710 if( ext->pm_state == PM_ACTIVE ) {
3711 sdmmc_bkops( hba, CAM_TRUE );
3712 }
3713 break;
3714
3715 case SDMMC_PM_TIMER:
3716 sdmmc_timer( hba );
3717 break;
3718
3719#ifdef SDMMC_POWMAN_SUP
3720 case SDMMC_POWMAN_UPDATE:
3721 if( ( status = sdmmc_powman_allowed_mode_list_update( hba ) ) ) {
3722 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: sdmmc_pm_allowed_mode_list_update() failed %s (%d)", __FUNCTION__, strerror( status ), status );
3723 }
3724 break;
3725
3726 case SDMMC_POWMAN_RECONNECT:
3727 if( ( stat = sdmmc_powman_connect( hba ) ) ) {
3728 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: sdmmc_powman_connect() failed %s (%d)", __FUNCTION__, strerror( status ), status );
3729 }
3730 break;
3731#endif
3732
3733 case _PULSE_CODE_DISCONNECT:
3734 return( NULL );
3735
3736 default:
3737// cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: unknown pulse rid %d, type %x, subtype %d, pulse %x, value %x, scoid %x", __FUNCTION__, rid, pulse.type, pulse.subtype, pulse.code, pulse.value.sival_int, pulse.scoid );
3738 break;
3739 }
3740
3741 if( ext->nexus == NULL ) {
3742 sdmmc_start_ccb( hba );
3743 }
3744 }
3745
3746 return( NULL );
3747}

3749// This function is called by the XPT to request that the SIM be initialized.
3750int sdmmc_sim_init( SIM_HBA *hba, int path )
3751{
3752 hba = hba;
3753 path = path;

3758// This fuction is called when the driver is terminating. It is provided
3759// to perform any necessary cleanup before exiting.
3760int sdmmc_sim_detach( void )
3761{
3762 SIM_HBA *hba;
3763 SIM_HBA *nhba;
3764
3765 sdmmc_ctrl.cflags |= SDMMC_CFLAG_ENUMERATING;
3766 if( sdio_disconnect( sdmmc_ctrl.connection ) == EBUSY ) {
3767 for( hba = TAILQ_FIRST( &sdmmc_ctrl.hlist ); hba; hba = nhba ) {
3768 nhba = TAILQ_NEXT(hba, hlink);
3769 sdmmc_detach( hba, CAM_TRUE );
3770 }
3771 sdio_disconnect( sdmmc_ctrl.connection );
3772 }
3773
3774 return( CAM_SUCCESS );
3775}

3777// This function is used to reset the specified SCSI bus. This
3778// request shall slways result in the SCSI RST signal being
3779// asserted.
3780__attribute__((used))
3781static int sdmmc_reset_bus( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_RESETBUS * const ccb )
3782{
3783 simq_scsi_reset( hba->simq );
3784 xpt_async( AC_BUS_RESET, hba->pathid, -1, -1, NULL, 0 );
3785 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
3786}

3788// This function is used to reset the specified SCSI target. This
3789// function should not be used in normal operation, but if I/O to a
3790// particular device hangs up for some reason, drivers can abort the
3791// I/O and reset the device before trying again. This request shall
3792// always result in a bus device reset message being issued over SCSI.
3793__attribute__((used))
3794static int sdmmc_reset_dev( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_RESETDEV * const ccb )
3795{
3796 simq_reset_dev( hba->simq, ccb );
3797 xpt_async( AC_SENT_BDR, hba->pathid, -1, -1, NULL, 0 );
3798 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
3799}

3823// This function is used to get information on the installed HBA
3824// hardware, including number of HBAs installed
3825static int sdmmc_path_inq( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB_PATHINQ *ccb )
3826{
3827 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
3828
3829 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
3830
3831 ccb->cam_version_num = CAM_VERSION;
3832 ccb->cam_initiator_id = 7;
3833 ccb->cam_hba_inquiry = 0;
3834 ccb->cam_target_sprt = 0;
3835 ccb->cam_hba_misc = 0;
3836 ccb->cam_hba_eng_cnt = 0;
3837 ccb->cam_sim_priv = SIM_PRIV;
3838 ccb->cam_async_flags = AC_BUS_RESET;
3839 memset( ccb->cam_vuhba_flags, 0x00, sizeof( *ccb->cam_vuhba_flags ) );
3840
3841 if( !( ext->hc_inf.caps & HC_CAP_DMA ) ) {
3842 ccb->cam_vuhba_flags[CAM_VUHBA_FLAGS] = CAM_VUHBA_FLAG_PTR;
3843 }
3844 else {
3845 ccb->cam_vuhba_flags[CAM_VUHBA_FLAGS] = CAM_VUHBA_FLAG_PTR | CAM_VUHBA_FLAG_DMA;
3846 if( ( ext->hc_inf.caps & HC_CAP_DMA_MSK ) != HC_CAP_DMA64 ) {
3847 ccb->cam_vuhba_flags[CAM_VUHBA_EFLAGS] |= CAM_VUHBA_EFLAG_DMA_32;
3848 }
3849 }
3850
3851 ccb->cam_vuhba_flags[CAM_VUHBA_FLAGS] |= CAM_VUHBA_FLAG_MLUN;
3852
3853 if( ( ext->eflags & SDMMC_EFLAG_DEVNAME ) ) {
3854 ccb->cam_vuhba_flags[CAM_VUHBA_EFLAGS] |= CAM_VUHBA_EFLAG_DEVNAME;
3855 }
3856
3857 ccb->cam_vuhba_flags[CAM_VUHBA_EFLAGS] |= CAM_VUHBA_EFLAG_PNP;
3858
3859 ccb->cam_vuhba_flags[CAM_VUHBA_MAX_LINKED] = 1;
3860 ccb->cam_vuhba_flags[CAM_VUHBA_MAX_SG] = (uint8_t)ext->hc_inf.sg_max;
3861
3862 strlcpy( (char *)ccb->cam_sim_vid, "SDMMC", sizeof( ccb->cam_sim_vid ) );
3863 strlcpy( (char *)ccb->cam_hba_vid, (char *)ext->hc_inf.name, sizeof( ccb->cam_hba_vid ) );
3864
3865 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
3866}
3867
3868static int sdmmc_sim_action_devctl( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB * const ccb )
3869{
3870 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
3871 CCB_HEADER *ch;
3872 CCB_DEVCTL *dccb;
3873 int cstatus;
3874
3875 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
3876 ch = (CCB_HEADER *)ccb;
3877 dccb = (CCB_DEVCTL *)ccb;
3878 cstatus = CAM_REQ_INPROG;
3879
3880 if( dccb->cam_devctl_dcmd == DCMD_SDMMC_DRVR_STATE ) {
3881 SDMMC_DRVR_STATE *ds;
3882
3883 ds = dccb->cam_devctl_data;
3884
3885 if( ext->drvr_state != ds->state ) { // see if we are currently in the requested state
3886 ch->cam_flags |= CAM_SIM_QHEAD; // insert request at the head of simq.
3887
3888 switch( ds->state ) {
3889 case SDMMC_DRVR_PAUSE:
3890 cstatus = CAM_REQ_INPROG; // pause request will use the normal enqueue process/pulse
3891 break;
3892
3893 case SDMMC_DRVR_RUN: {
3894 CCB_RELSIM rccb;
3895
3896 rccb.cam_ch = *ch; // copy header information, ie target,lun, etc...
3897 simq_ccb_enqueue( hba->simq, ccb );
3898 sdmmc_rel_simq( hba, &rccb ); // release/unfreeze simq
3899 return( CAM_REQ_CMP );
3900 }
3901
3902 default:
3903 cstatus = CAM_REQ_CMP;
3904 dccb->cam_devctl_status = EINVAL;
3905 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: DCMD_SDMMC_DRVR_STATE Invalid state %d", __FUNCTION__, ds->state );
3906 break;
3907 }
3908 }
3909 else {
3910 cstatus = CAM_REQ_CMP;
3911 dccb->cam_devctl_status = EOK;
3912 }
3913
3914 if( cstatus ) {
3915 ch->cam_status = cstatus;
3916 if( !( ch->cam_flags & CAM_DIS_CALLBACK ) && dccb->cam_cbfcnp ) {
3917 (dccb->cam_cbfcnp)( ccb ); // perform callback, note: simq_post_ccb not used since request hasn't be queued
3918 }
3919 }
3920 }
3921
3922 return( cstatus );
3923}
3924
3925// All CCB requests to the SIM are made through this function.
3926int sdmmc_sim_action( SIM_HBA * const hba, CCB * const ccbp )
3927{
3928 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
3929 CCB_HEADER *ccb;
3930 int status;
3931
3932 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
3933 ccb = (CCB_HEADER *)ccbp;
3934 status = CAM_REQ_CMP;
3935
3936 if( ( ccb->cam_flags & ( CAM_CDB_PHYS | CAM_NXT_CCB_PHYS |
3937 CAM_CALLBCK_PHYS | CAM_SNS_BUF_PHYS ) ) ) {
3938 ccb->cam_status = CAM_NO_HBA;
3939 return( CAM_FAILURE );
3940 }
3941
3942 if( ccb->cam_target_id > ext->ntargs ) {
3943 ccb->cam_status = CAM_TID_INVALID;
3944 return( CAM_FAILURE );
3945 }
3946 else if( ccb->cam_target_lun > ext->targets[ccb->cam_target_id].nluns ) {
3947 ccb->cam_status = CAM_LUN_INVALID;
3948 return( CAM_FAILURE );
3949 }
3950 else {
3951 // nothing
3952 }
3953
3954 switch( ccb->cam_func_code ) {
3955 case XPT_NOOP:
3956 break;
3957
3958 case XPT_SCSI_IO:
3959 case XPT_RESET_BUS:
3960 case XPT_RESET_DEV:
3961 case XPT_ABORT:
3962 status = CAM_REQ_INPROG;
3963 break;
3964
3965 case XPT_DEVCTL:
3966 status = sdmmc_sim_action_devctl( hba, ccb );
3967 if( status == CAM_REQ_CMP ) {
3968 return( CAM_SUCCESS );
3969 }
3970 break;
3971
3972 case XPT_REL_SIMQ:
3973 status = sdmmc_rel_simq( hba, (CCB_RELSIM *)ccb );
3974 break;
3975
3976 case XPT_TERM_IO:
3977 status = sdmmc_term_io( hba, (CCB_TERMIO *)ccb );
3978 break;
3979
3980 case XPT_PATH_INQ:
3981 status = sdmmc_path_inq( hba, (CCB_PATHINQ *)ccb );
3982 break;
3983
3984 case XPT_GDEV_TYPE:
3985 case XPT_SDEV_TYPE:
3986 case XPT_SASYNC_CB:
3987 // These are not serviced by the SIM, the XPT should do them
3988 status = CAM_REQ_INVALID;
3989 break;
3990
3991 case XPT_EN_LUN:
3992 case XPT_TARGET_IO:
3993 status = CAM_FUNC_NOTAVAIL;
3994 break;
3995
3996 case XPT_VUNIQUE:
3997 // No special vendor unique commands
3998 status = CAM_REQ_INVALID;
3999 break;
4000
4001 case XPT_ENG_INQ:
4002 case XPT_ENG_EXEC:
4003 default:
4004 status = CAM_REQ_INVALID;
4005 break;
4006 }
4007
4008 ccb->cam_status = (uchar_t)status;
4009 if( status == CAM_REQ_INPROG ) {
4010#ifdef SDMMC_TRACE
4011 sdmmc_trace_event( SDMMC_TRACE_EVENT, "%s: ccb %p, cmd %x", __FUNCTION__, ccb, ((CCB_SCSIIO *)ccb)->cam_cdb_io.cam_cdb_bytes[0] );
4012#endif
4013 simq_ccb_enqueue( hba->simq, (CCB_SCSIIO *)ccb );
4014 if( ( pthread_self( ) != hba->tid ) && ( ext->nexus == NULL ) ) {
4015 if( MsgSendPulse( hba->coid, hba->priority, SIM_ENQUEUE, 0 ) == -1 ) {
4016 }
4017 }
4018 }
4019
4020 return( CAM_SUCCESS );
4021}
4022
4023int sdmmc_sim_attach( CAM_ENTRY * const centry )
4024{
4025 SIM_HBA *hba;
4026 SIM_HBA *nhba;
4027 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
4028 int busno;
4029 sdio_device_instance_t *inst;
4030 sdio_funcs_t funcs = { .nfuncs = 3, .insertion = sdmmc_sdio_insertion, .removal = sdmmc_sdio_removal, .event = sdmmc_sdio_event };
4031 sdio_device_ident_t interest = { .vid = SDIO_CONNECT_WILDCARD, .did = SDIO_CONNECT_WILDCARD, .dtype = SDIO_CONNECT_WILDCARD, .ccd = SDIO_CONNECT_WILDCARD };
4032 sdio_connect_parm_t connect_parm;
4033
4034 memset( &connect_parm, 0, sizeof( sdio_connect_parm_t ) );
4035 connect_parm.vsdio = SDIO_VERSION;
4036 connect_parm.argc = sdmmc_ctrl.argc;
4037 connect_parm.argv = sdmmc_ctrl.argv;
4038
4039 memcpy( &connect_parm.funcs, &funcs, sizeof( sdio_funcs_t ) );
4040 memcpy( &connect_parm.ident, &interest, sizeof( sdio_device_ident_t ) );
4041
4042 if( ( sdmmc_ctrl.cflags & SDMMC_CFLG_ARGS_ERR ) ) {
4043 return( CAM_FAILURE );
4044 }
4045
4046 sdmmc_ctrl.cflags |= SDMMC_CFLAG_ENUMERATING;
4047
4048 // null insertion callback on targeted attach
4049 if( sdmmc_ctrl.nhba && !( sdmmc_ctrl.cflags & SDMMC_CFLAG_SCAN ) ) {
4050 funcs.insertion = NULL;
4051 }
4052
4053 if( sdio_connect( &connect_parm, &sdmmc_ctrl.connection ) != EOK ) {
4054 return( CAM_FAILURE );
4055 }
4056
4057 if( ( sdmmc_ctrl.cflags & SDMMC_CFLAG_SCAN ) ) {
4058 sdmmc_ctrl.cflags |= SDMMC_CFLAG_ENUMERATING;
4059 hba = TAILQ_FIRST( &sdmmc_ctrl.hlist );
4060
4061 for( busno = 0; busno < SDMMC_MAX_BUS ; busno++ ) {
4062 if( hba == NULL ) {
4063 hba = sdmmc_alloc_hba( );
4064 if( hba == NULL ) {
4065 break;
4066 }
4067 }
4068 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
4069 inst = &ext->instance;
4070 inst->path = busno;
4071 inst->func = 0;
4072
4073 if( sdmmc_attach( hba, sdmmc_ctrl.connection, inst ) != CAM_SUCCESS ) {
4074 if( ext->eflags ) {
4075 // don't free hba if there are command line options
4076 ext->instance.path = SDIO_CONNECT_WILDCARD;
4077 continue;
4078 }
4079
4080 sdmmc_detach( hba, CAM_TRUE );
4081 }
4082
4083 hba = NULL;
4084 }
4085 }
4086 else { // attach to specific buses/devices
4087 for( hba = TAILQ_FIRST( &sdmmc_ctrl.hlist ); hba; hba = nhba ) {
4088 nhba = TAILQ_NEXT( hba, hlink );
4089 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
4090 inst = &ext->instance;
4091 inst->ident.vid = (uint16_t)( hba->cfg.Device_ID.DevID & 0xffffU );
4092 inst->ident.did = (uint16_t)( hba->cfg.Device_ID.DevID >> 16 );
4093
4094 if( sdmmc_attach( hba, sdmmc_ctrl.connection, inst ) != CAM_SUCCESS ) {
4095 sdmmc_detach( hba, CAM_TRUE );
4096 }
4097 }
4098 }
4099
4100 sdmmc_ctrl.cflags &= ~SDMMC_CFLAG_ENUMERATING;
4101
4102 sdio_enum( sdmmc_ctrl.connection, SDIO_ENUM_ENABLE ); // enable change detect
4103
4104 return( CAM_SUCCESS );
4105}
4106
4107int sdmmc_sim_args( char *options )
4108{
4109 SIM_HBA *hba;
4110 SIM_SDMMC_EXT *ext;
4111 int val;
4112 int opt;
4113 int status;
4114 char *value;
4115
4116 enum {
4117 OPTION_WITHOUT_ARGS = 0,
4118 OPTION_NONE = OPTION_WITHOUT_ARGS,
4119
4120 OPTION_WITH_ARGS,
4121 OPTION_BUSNO = OPTION_WITH_ARGS,
4122 OPTION_FUNC,
4123 OPTION_BKOPS,
4124 OPTION_CACHE,
4125 OPTION_PARTITIONS,
4126 OPTION_PWROFF_NOTIFY,
4127 OPTION_RELWR,
4128 OPTION_POWMAN,
4129 OPTION_SCCBM,
4130 OPTION_BS,
4131
4132 OPTION_VAR_ARGS,
4133 };
4134
4135 static char *opts[] = {
4136 [OPTION_NONE] = "none", // place holder for option without args
4137
4138 [OPTION_BUSNO] = "busno",
4139 [OPTION_FUNC] = "func",
4140 [OPTION_BKOPS] = "bkops",
4141 [OPTION_CACHE] = "cache",
4142 [OPTION_PARTITIONS] = "partitions",
4143 [OPTION_PWROFF_NOTIFY] = "pwroff_notify",
4144 [OPTION_RELWR] = "relwr",
4145 [OPTION_POWMAN] = "powman",
4146 [OPTION_SCCBM] = "sccbm",
4147 [OPTION_BS] = "bs",
4148
4149 NULL
4150 };
4151
4152 if( *options == '\0' ) { // called when command name includes the module name
4153 if( sdmmc_ctrl.nhba == 0 ) {
4154 sdmmc_ctrl.cflags |= SDMMC_CFLAG_SCAN;
4155 }
4156 return( CAM_SUCCESS );
4157 }
4158
4159 if( sdmmc_ctrl.nhba > SDMMC_MAX_HBA ) { // max hba's reached
4160 return( CAM_FAILURE );
4161 }
4162
4163 hba = sdmmc_alloc_hba( );
4164 if( hba == NULL ) {
4165 return( CAM_FAILURE );
4166 }
4167
4168 ext = (SIM_SDMMC_EXT *)hba->ext;
4169 status = EOK;
4170
4171 while( (*options != '\0') && (status == EOK) ) {
4172 opt = getsubopt( &options, opts, &value );
4173 if( opt == -1 ) {
4174 if( sim_drvr_options( hba, value ) == EOK ) {
4175 continue;
4176 }
4177 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 0, 0, "%s: Invalid sdmmc option '%s'", __FUNCTION__, value );
4178 status = EINVAL;
4179 break;
4180 }
4181
4182 if( opt < OPTION_VAR_ARGS ) {
4183 if( opt < OPTION_WITH_ARGS ) {
4184 if( value != NULL ) {
4185 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 0, 0, "%s: Unexpected argument for '%s'", __FUNCTION__, opts[ opt ] );
4186 break;
4187 }
4188 }
4189 else {
4190 if( (value == NULL) || (*value == '\0') ) {
4191 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 0, 0, "%s: Missing argument for '%s'", __FUNCTION__, opts[ opt ] );
4192 break;
4193 }
4194 }
4195 }
4196
4197 switch( opt ) {
4198// options without args follow
4199
4200
4201// options with args follow
4202
4203 case OPTION_BUSNO: // busno
4204 val = cam_parse_number( value );
4205 if( val == CAM_INVALID_NUM ) {
4206 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 0, 0, "%s: Invalid busno", __FUNCTION__ );
4207 status = EINVAL;
4208 break;
4209 }
4210 ext->instance.path = (uint32_t)val;
4211 break;
4212
4213 case OPTION_FUNC: // func
4214 val = cam_parse_number( value );
4215 if( val == CAM_INVALID_NUM ) {
4216 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 0, 0, "%s: Invalid func", __FUNCTION__ );
4217 status = EINVAL;
4218 break;
4219 }
4220 ext->instance.func = (uint32_t)val;
4221 break;
4222
4223 case OPTION_BKOPS: // bkops
4224 if( !strcmp( value, "on" ) ) {
4225 ext->eflags |= SDMMC_EFLAG_BKOPS;
4226 }
4227 else if( !strcmp( value, "auto" ) ) {
4228 ext->eflags |= SDMMC_EFLAG_BKOPS_AUTO;
4229 }
4230 else {
4231 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: Invalid bkops", __FUNCTION__ );
4232 status = EINVAL;
4233 }
4234 break;
4235
4236 case OPTION_CACHE: // cache
4237#ifdef SDMMC_CACHE_SUP
4238 if( !strcmp( value, "on" ) ) {
4239 ext->eflags |= SDMMC_EFLAG_CACHE;
4240 }
4241#endif
4242 break;
4243
4244 case OPTION_PARTITIONS: // partitions
4245 if( !strcmp( value, "on" ) ) {
4246 ext->eflags |= SDMMC_EFLAG_PARTITIONS;
4247 }
4248 break;
4249
4250 case OPTION_PWROFF_NOTIFY: // pwroff_notify
4251 if( !strcmp( value, "short" ) ) {
4252 ext->eflags |= SDMMC_EFLAG_PWROFF_NOTIFY;
4253 ext->pwroff_notify = SDIO_POWER_OFF_SHORT;
4254 }
4255 else if( !strcmp( value, "long" ) ) {
4256 ext->eflags |= SDMMC_EFLAG_PWROFF_NOTIFY;
4257 ext->pwroff_notify = SDIO_POWER_OFF_LONG;
4258 }
4259 else {
4260 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 1, 1, "%s: Invalid power off notification mode", __FUNCTION__ );
4261 status = EINVAL;
4262 }
4263 break;
4264
4265 case OPTION_RELWR: // relwr reliable write
4266 if( !strcmp( value, "on" ) ) {
4267 ext->eflags |= SDMMC_EFLAG_RELWR;
4268 }
4269 break;
4270
4271 case OPTION_POWMAN: // powman
4272 ext->eflags |= SDMMC_EFLAG_POWMAN;
4273 if( ext->powman_name != NULL ) {
4274 free( ext->powman_name );
4275 }
4276 ext->powman_name = strdup( value );
4277 break;
4278
4279 case OPTION_SCCBM: // sccbm=max set max loops in sdmmc_start_ccb fcn
4280 val = cam_parse_number( value );
4281 if( (val == CAM_INVALID_NUM) || (val == 0) ) { // 1 ..
4282 cam_slogf( _SLOGC_SIM_MMC, _SLOG_ERROR, 0, 0, "%s: Invalid start ccb max", __FUNCTION__ );
4283 status = EINVAL;
4284 break;
4285 }
4286 ext->start_ccb_max = val;
4287 break;
4288
4289 case OPTION_BS:
4290 status = sim_bs_args( hba, value );
4291 break;
4292
4293// options with variable args follow
4294
4295 default:
4296 break;
4297 }
4298 }
4299
4300 if( ext->instance.path == SDIO_CONNECT_WILDCARD ) {
4301 sdmmc_ctrl.cflags |= SDMMC_CFLAG_SCAN;
4302 if( hba->priority ) {
4303 sdmmc_ctrl.priority = hba->priority;
4304 }
4305 }
4306
4307 if( status != EOK ) {
4308 sdmmc_free_hba( hba );
4309 sdmmc_ctrl.cflags |= SDMMC_CFLG_ARGS_ERR;
4310 }
4311
4312 return( ( status == EOK ) ? CAM_SUCCESS : CAM_FAILURE );
4313}
